body:
I’ll always put New Hampshire first.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250427-1?refcode=em20250427-1939&amount=5&refcode2=1939_21716_EmGfMC&akid=1939%2E21716%2EEmGfMC)
I’m Congressman Chris Pappas, and Congresswoman Sarah McBride said I could reach out with some big news:

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Right now, Donald Trump is testing the bounds of his power by arresting and deporting immigrants with no due process. Here’s where things stand:
We’ve all seen the horrifying videos online. Immigrants are being kidnapped off the streets, pulled from their homes or their cars, even from citizenship hearings. Some are being disappeared to detention centers across the country, and others are deported to a foreign prison while their families have no idea where they are.
In many cases, the rationale for these deportations are baseless accusations of gang ties — or simply having a tattoo. Being in the wrong place at the wrong time. And in some cases, it all comes down to an administrative error.
That’s what happened to Kilmar Abrego Garcia, a resident of Maryland. He was deported due to a paperwork error (seriously), and is now imprisoned in El Salvador. The Supreme Court unanimously ruled that the Trump administration must bring Kilmar back, but so far Trump is refusing to comply.
This isn’t just cruel — it’s unlawful, dangerous, and it’s happening across the country, in our neighborhoods and communities.
And now Trump is saying that he wants to deport U.S. citizens, too.
If you or someone you know is stopped by ICE, you have rights. Here’s what to know:
✅ You have the right to remain silent.
✅ You do not have to answer questions about your immigration status. (But if you are a non-citizen and have your immigration papers on you, you must show them if asked by an immigration agent.)
✅ You have the right to speak to a lawyer.
✅ And you do not have to let ICE into your home without a signed warrant.
The ACLU has English and Spanish language resources that are available here [https://www.aclu.org/know-your-rights/immigrants-rights] — please share with your friends, family, and neighbors. The more people who know about their rights, the harder it is for this administration to get away with these abuses.
We can’t stop all the harm overnight — but we can do what we can to protect each other right now.
More to come soon,
Sara

**April 27, 2025** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,
I’m so happy to check in with you personally this week. After a successful surgery and some much-needed recovery time, I’m slowly beginning to ease back into work. I’m incredibly grateful for your prayers, encouragement, and support—it’s meant the world to me.
This week, I wanted to share my latest commentary, one that feels especially urgent given everything we’re facing in Colorado right now.
In _[From Superior Elementary to Sex Camps—Colorado Parental Rights Under Attack](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_ , I trace how the seeds of today's radical agenda were planted years ago, starting in my own children's elementary school. What began with quiet gender ideology programs has now escalated into Sex Ed Summer Camps for kids as young as 10, “porn literacy” lessons, and bills like [HB25-1312](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), which could strip parental rights simply for affirming biological reality.
For years, many of us were mocked or dismissed for warning about what was coming. But today, the truth is undeniable: **Colorado’s education system has been weaponized against families.**
From mandated "comprehensive sex ed" to gender-transition counseling without parental consent, activists have entrenched themselves deep inside our schools, public health systems, and even our laws. Now, if bills like HB25-1312 succeed, parents could be legally punished for refusing to comply.
On April 30th, the Senate Judiciary Committee will hold a hearing on HB25-1312. I personally encourage every concerned Coloradan to sign up to testify or attend the rally at the Capitol that morning. Details are in the article linked below.
This is not just another bad bill—it’s a turning point. Our children's innocence, families' rights, and future freedom are on the line.
You can read my full commentary here:
📖 [From Superior Elementary to Sex Camps — Colorado Parental Rights Under Attack](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Thank you again for your prayers and patience while I continue my recovery. And thank you for standing up for the next generation.
In liberty and truth,
Heidi

Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation – not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read “Free The Uyghurs.” After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc.

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans.

name: Troy
subject: From the scrapbook (8 photos)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Troy Downing for Congress
body:
My story’s a little different than most.

| | | [](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-LDg)
---
Never could this young boy have imagined he’d one day be sending an email like this.

Peter, it's Troy Downing.

If you don’t have much time, all you need to know about me is that **I only care about three things: God, family, and country.** **[I’m fighting in Congress to defend those three things for myself and every American.](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-gPttMbV6g)**
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-HKTnA)
---
Growing up, I was a bit of a nerd. I studied mathematics and computer science in college. Then, I started my own business, which merged with Yahoo!. I started other small businesses in insurance and real estate, but then my life changed forever...

Like millions of Americans, September 11th was a turning point.

**I immediately enlisted in the United States Air Force/ANG.** I served two tours of duty in Afghanistan as part of a Combat Search and Rescue (CSAR) squadron.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-ALGrRsMCXhV7A)
---
After eight years of service, I was honorably discharged from the Air Force and returned home to Montana with my wife and kids.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
We are partners in a local distillery in Bozeman, and when the COVID pandemic hit, our company went above and beyond to help our friends and neighbors. There was a shortage of toilet paper, sanitizing wipes, and hand sanitizer in every store.

We quickly turned our whiskey distillery into a hand sanitizer production facility to provide free hand sanitizer to families, first responders, and hospitals.
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
In the Combat Search and Rescue (CSAR) Community, we live by this motto:

**“These things we do, that others may live.”**

I’ve taken this motto with me in everything I do. I’ve taught my kids to live by this. And now, my public service is not finished. **[I’m fighting in Congress to preserve our American way of life, protect our God-given rights, and defend our nation with everything I’ve got.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._6AyulV_BvRmkZg9VzmP7Q)**
---
[](https://trk.emails.troydowning.-5C8Ej7WeYrGtqtq6CQ)
---
I’m fighting in Congress for **GOD** so we will never forget that we are one nation UNDER God.

I’m fighting in Congress for our **FAMILIES** so our kids have every opportunity to succeed.

I’m fighting in Congress for our **COUNTRY** so every future generation can still call the United States of America their home and the best country that has ever graced God’s creation.

Peter, defending our conservative House Majority and advancing President Trump’s agenda won’t come cheap. Democrats are chomping at the bit to flip the House BLUE so they can turn every state into the next California! I can’t let that happen, but I’m hoping strong, loyal Patriots like you will help win this fight.

[**If you can spare just $5 or $10, that’s all it takes to make a difference – seriously!**](https://trk.emails.troydowning._WuwPm9eQ) I don’t have billionaires on speed dial or Hollywood award winners to campaign for me.

I depend on like-minded friends and neighbors like you to chip in a few bucks. **[If everyone reading this chips in $8, I’ll hit my goal!](https://trk.emails.troydowning._I77J1tQ)**
---
[ **DONATE TODAY**](https://trk.emails.troydowning._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI1MDQyOF9PSS1JWi4xMTAxMTdfdDE2MzIyMzAtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNTA0MjhfT0ktSVouMTEwMTE3X3QxNjMyMjMwLTI4OTkifQ/XxdzTpQtI20YJCYtH53gOQ)
---
[**I appreciate any and all support.**](https://trk.emails.troydowning._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI1MDQyOF9PSS1JWi4xMTAxMTdfdDE2MzIyMzAtMjg5OSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNTA0MjhfT0ktSVouMTEwMTE3X3QxNjMyMjMwLTI4OTkifQ/rlrhQf28IOtAl3G44rwAEg)

With your help, Peter, **we can save our country and put God, Family, and Country FIRST. **

God Bless,

Troy Downing (R-MT)

I’m fighting in Congress for our FAMILIES so our kids have every opportunity to succeed. I’m fighting in Congress for our COUNTRY so every future generation can still call the United States of America their home and the best country that has ever graced God’s creation. Peter, defending our conservative House Majority and advancing President Trump’s agenda won’t come cheap. Democrats are chomping at the bit to flip the House BLUE so they can turn every state into the next California! I can’t let that happen, but I’m hoping strong, loyal Patriots like you will help win this fight. I don’t have billionaires on speed dial or Hollywood award winners to campaign for me. I depend on like-minded friends and neighbors like you to chip in a few bucks. With your help, Peter, we can save our country and put God, Family, and Country FIRST. We need your prayers, donations, volunteer support, and your vote. Please visit the Winsome Sears for Governor website here: == | | | To our detractors, I want you to know: whether you voted for me or not, I still love you. After my SEAL Team PT workout Friday, I waived good morning to folks on their way to work. Over the last week or so, I have been having fun meeting folks all over the district. Tracy and I attended two churches on Easter, attended the White House Easter Egg Roll in DC with constituents from VA 05, met with Amherst GOP Chair John Ruff, visited law enforcement in Amherst, visited firefighters in Amherst, visited Hermle North America, toured Framatome in Lynchburg, visited Park View Community Mission, met with the Liberty University Football Coach, attended the Lynchburg City Council Meeting, visited Nelson County Sheriff's Office where I congratulated them for a hugely successful sting operation, visited many district farmers to discuss/ listen to their views on H2B visas and tariffs, met with Nelson County GOP chair Michael Hevener, visited S & P Global, answered questions on Tariffs, fentanyl, the border, legislation, and more as part of a 2 person panel for 70 Charlottesville constituents, visited Perrone Robotics, toured Biocore who help NFL athletes with safety standards, met folks at Farmington Country Club where I learned more about Thomas Jefferson and Charlottesville history , and more. Even ran into some indivisible folks from the opposing party. It really is amazing what we can achieve when we work as a team. America first is about protecting the American dream for all Americans. We all want to live work and raise our family in peace. I have my foot on the gas. We just completed two weeks working in district. Today, we head back to DC. | | == | I had the honor of recognizing Jesse Grapes, a fellow Christian, Veteran, and the President of the Benedictine Schools of Richmond, on the House Floor. A Marine who served 3 tours in Iraq, Jesse earned the Bronze Star & Purple Heart--and continues to serve through education. As a Navy SEAL, I know you can never have enough Marines around! == | Photos and Some of What I've Been Up To | | Virginia International Raceway | | Campbell County | | | I had the honor of serving as the keynote speaker at Mar-a-Lago. | | | Thank you to Powhatan County Republican Committee (PCRC) Chair David Robinson and the entire team for the opportunity to provide an update on President Trump, the budget blueprint, and other key issues. Your unwavering support for Republican elected officials and candidates sets a strong example -- one that leadership in the 5th Congressional District would be wise to emulate. We look forward to continued collaboration and engagement in the months ahead as we work to get Winsome Sears, Jason Miyares, our Lieutenant Governor candidate, Delegate Lee Ware, and many others across the finish line this November. | | | Dale and Treyse Hull of County Line Mini Mall & Cafe in Forest, Virginia joined me at the White House for Liberation Day! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Saturday, we had the privilege of meeting with constituents from across the 5th Congressional District at == 2025 Spring Fling in Rice, Virginia. Thank you == for introducing me to so many Patriots. Attendees included residents from Nottoway, Amelia, Prince Edward, Cumberland, Buckingham, Appomattox, and other surrounding communities. This was a great opportunity to hear your concerns, receive your prayers, and discuss your thoughtful ideas. | | | These Liberty University seniors took a moment to pray for me and for our country on the front steps of the U.S. Capitol during their tour. If you're interested in scheduling a Capitol tour, please contact our office. | | I took a day trip to visit the SpaceX Starbase in Texas to learn more about its capabilities and recent progress. | | Delegate Wendell Walker and our new RPV Chair, Senator Mark Peake. | | | | | My first bill will help get heavy logging trucks off the back roads and onto the highways with other heavy trucks. | | == | == | | == | As a member of the Armed Services Committee, I highlighted the vital role aircraft carriers play in our national defense. Watch here: == | | | | | | | | | Thank you, to a room full of Charlottesville constituents, for the thoughtful questions and the opportunity to engage in a respectful, civil manner. I walked in not knowing anyone and left with new friends and deeper understanding. It is an honor to be your representative. God bless America! | | | Stay strong--Church isn't just for Sundays. We know the devil divides, but Jesus reconciles. In a world with hate, division, and judgement, let's choose to be people of love, unity, and grace. 1 John 4:8 reminds us, 'Whoever does not love does not know God, because God is love.' Let's be the light! | | | | | | | Radical democrats looking to get 20 years in jail for setting Tesla's on fire. | | Jeff Katz WRVA Radio | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | == | "Who could imagine so great a mercy..." Bethel Music, Brian & Jenn Johnson | VICTORY. This is a song I listen to often: == | | | | | Two Navy SEAL brothers. Robert J. O'Neill--shot 911 terrorist Osama Bin Laden in the face. | | President Trump is bringing manufacturing and jobs back to the USA. | | | | Robert F. Kennedy Jr. was sworn in as the 26th Secretary of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services | | Laura Ingraham used to work out at my fitness program SEAL Team PT. | | Vice President JD Vance | | | | | | | Bethany Harrison Lynchburg Commonwealth Atorney | | Amherst GOP Chair John Ruff | | | | | | | | | | | | | Fellow Virginian Carrie Sheffield wrote Motorhome Prophecies, a powerful journey from darkness to hope and redemption. | | | | | A well-regulated Militia, being necessary to the security of a free State, the right of the people to keep and bear Arms, shall not be infringed. | | | | | | | | | Three Navy SEAL brothers. Rep. Ryan Zinke was one of my BUD/s Instructors. Only 19 out of 200 graduated my SEAL class! | | Rep August Pfluger RSC Chair and F22 Pilot. | | | | | | Hanover Sheriff David Hines and his wife. | | | | | | Delegate Buddy Fowler | | | Senator Luther Cifers | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | USS Enterprise CVN 80 under construction in Newport News. | | | Two Navy SEAL brothers in Goochland County. Thank you Supervisor Johnathan Lyle for supporting our first responders and our veterans! | | | | Rachel Tate is teacher of the year and she runs the Goochland High School Veterans project. Thank you for helping others! | | | | | | | | | A Green Beret brother who participated in some of the same missions I did back in the day, still speaks better Spanish than me, and he lives in the 5th! | | | The Three Amigos! | | | | | He is not here; He is risen! body:
At least 11 people were killed and more than two dozen injured Saturday night when a [driver plowed an SUV into crowds](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFugzAQxvGnMVuQOZ-DM3jowpauHZGxD3LVBUfGAaVPX6Wv0PmTftL3_7qO18DC6_IZ7uTrnMeVjk2oVirjHtaYnzuVWsJC6bWFZ-KJRUbQYE8aT-DGFFheIzbJz0RApiHf9WidsR2a5uZjhKQvVhtjZoeIDi-REs3G4Tm6FBr2b00juE53AF1rJ7R0mfrZJg2miwo1Ja65tN-Z13qjWV55p9LGfG_E32p9bMp8KBgUDMdxtNMU35uC4X1GwSC8k4IhQkJH5WfppTbFp8fBIryde4V6uQeWP7H-K8Pu4TcAAP__rpNwvg) at a Filipino festival in Vancouver, police said.

| | |
---
| | |
# Monday, April 28, 2025
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1881, notorious outlaw [Billy the Kid](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFyhCAUANDTYKcDH1iwoEhjt2lTOghf_RmUHWR1vH0muUIu8Ir39RyfnhLty6ff0NU5jzteR8JasYyn30N-n1hq8QvG-_DvSBOlNAIH3XLVgh2jp3SPqoluRgSUDTphlLZSCyWb1Rndh970ejZhnoyZrJCopI2Bi4flD92Q-9W4Aiu4ABCdnpTGfjKzjhykCExxjFRz6b4z7XXFOd35xNKFvDXJrbW-DiY_GAwMhuu6upRDt-STwUAVNwZDzdHfLe3tSkfN5WYw-Feh1IJlMDTFxddFKdHxMEzxZfOU_vD6r5HTwU8AAAD__z35dCE) escaped from the Lincoln County jail in New Mexico. He evaded capture until July 14, when he was ambushed and killed by Sheriff Pat Garrett. Today's the day: [_The Flyover_ podcast is officially launching](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-OhCAYBPCnkU4DH7C6BcU12-1Vl2xJ-POhXFA2iBrf_uLdI1w7k_kV83rqp4kpLuOnmVHVkPWCx5qwVix6N4vL246lFjOiP1ez-WhjShooyJaKFgbtTUynFsSrgAjICSrWCzlwyQQnk3LhfuNWBGndnQsOkjPj-kFKGwbOHJCoLo0KGBhlAKyTVki82z5IT4Ez1wiKPtZcuu8clzphSGfesXQuzySpqdb32vCPBh4NPI7j6M681c3i1V-hoC9T3dR-Tdg-_qakKP8-YkpxvfWNoONsYvr16r9O2BX8BAAA___rbXBy). If you don't have time to read--or just prefer to listen--you can catch our 15-minute news roundup on the go, wherever your morning takes you. We're excited to share what we've been working on! A huge thank you to our readers who shared thoughtful, practical feedback in our recent focus group. You helped shape this new way to deliver the stories that matter. And if you'd like to support _The Flyover_ as we grow, we'd be honored if you [contributed directly.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFvwyAUhH8N3mzBA0wyMFSqvKVrRwvDc0yFIcLPjvzvq1RdOnc93d0nfZ-38eZiivn-4Va0NJcx43NLSIR1PFz2ZT-wUnV3DOfm9hCnmNIIHHTLVQuXMbiYzlE1wc6IgLJBK4zSF6mFks1ir16BkpOZr0KYvnc9oNe6B69nIwy4JtrXG1dwEVwAiE5PSuN1MrMOHKTwTHEMkUrtvkrMtOCcznJg7XxZm2QXosfG5BuDgcGwod8rdi5jKPRqMBhowfZ3w2BYMD3avxGTg1vLnonJd6GbasPjGVOKW2-Y4vfVxfQDo38ZOix8BwAA__--7nny) We depend on your support!

|

## Titanic Letter Sells for $399,000
A letter written aboard the _Titanic_ by Colonel Archibald Gracie, one of the ship’s most notable survivors, has shattered records by selling for $399,000 at auction, far exceeding its original $75,000 estimate. [See the letter here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvgzAQBeBfA5uRfbaBDB66ZEvXjsjYR7jqwJHtEPHvq7Q_ofvTe_re1226eWLa759-Q1eXNO34Koy1Yp4Ov4f0PDDX7O8Yz-KfkWZinkCCFdIIGKfoic_JtNEtiIC6RacGY0dtldHt6sbxomIve9RGwYy9wsFrr3DAHr2C0JJ7t0kDo5IKQHV2NhYv87DYKEGr0BiJkWrK3Xeiva648JkOzF1IW8turfVRGv3RwLWBa_DdW9Cdfk3pnWjgWqn6nYIoz3zQkbL484mCzEVkDClHAdIauEhlurVu3GYXHy9iptIPjZH3zRP_DtZ_vXQ4-AkAAP__YMh8UQ). Penned on April 10, 1912, the day Gracie boarded, the letter reflects his [early impressions of the ship](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDtuwzAQRE8jdTKWS1ISCxZp3DltSoGfpb0BLRoULcO3D5QcIeVggBm893VZLo4zr9dPdyfbUllWem2ZWqO67G4N5blTbdVdKb4394zsOecFAfUAasB5iY7ze1F9tIkISfZkxaT0LLVQsr9ZQFJgwGEyiNoHMh7GMU0QZmGi1j3bYw0UzgIEojhprzQZPyUdAaUInQKK3Eo9fRde241Sfped6imUe5_trbXH1smPDs8dnt3jADiqI9TGIVOH58bNrRyGP7LBPUPjsg5ayySSFtGN82yElJPxEMcxQjTOS-qrjY8X58zbOHUKrnfH-fe3_UvWbvEnAAD__4LafFk) and was successfully sent during _Titanic’s_ final stop at Queenstown, Ireland, before later reaching its recipient in London. Just hours before the sinking, Gracie played squash, swam in the ship’s pool, attended a church service, and mingled with fellow passengers. Later that night, he was awoken by the sudden silence of the engines and rushed to assist women and children into lifeboats. Gracie survived by finding refuge on an overturned collapsible boat, and later wrote a book about his experiences. Find out [more about Gracie here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFurDAQAL8GOpC9mAMKF6-hu9emRIu9wEaLfTI-EH8fJcofpJxmRpqP5_REFg7rf9zJ5iVOga5DKGdK04nBxfdJKSdcyd8Hvj3PLDKBgrZSpoJ-8shyT6b0diECakqyujNt37TaNOVml3buNS7wMDBgPz8GB42DZtADOexVV7L9tikDvVYaQNftbFoa5m5pvYJGu8Io8pxjqj8jh7zRInc8KdUu7qXYLefXUTT_ChgLGK_rqim420l8kWesMmcM7LCOaS1g_MXqeKeTz5gKGF2UGEgqTG7jGcVXa0LHVG95lzJZ_7pYhI9HVxi17sjyU85_2nVa-AoAAP__pWyBbg).

Click below and check out today's episode wherever you get your podcasts. | | At Least 11 Killed in Vancouver Car Attack At least 11 people were killed and more than two dozen injured Saturday night when a at a Filipino festival in Vancouver, police said. Kai-Ji Adam Lo, 30, a local resident with a history of mental health issues, has been charged with , with more charges expected. Authorities , saying the victims, ranging from 5 to 65 years old, were enjoying a family-friendly celebration when tragedy struck. Vancouver’s police chief called it “,” and leaders across Canada offered condolences ahead of the country’s national election. Agriculture Secretary 'Preparing' for Farmer Bailout Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins indicated on Sunday that the Trump administration is ready to U.S. farmers if necessary as global trade wars continue to weaken agricultural exports. In an interview, Rollins said of the potential bailout, “The prayer is that that doesn't need to happen,” but that the administration is “preparing” for it. Sales of key agricultural commodities, particularly soybeans and pork, to China have amid tariff fallout, with net pork sales down 72% from the previous week, according to a new report. During lighter tariff battles with China during Trump’s first term, the administration paid out tens of billions of dollars in farm subsidies. Titanic Letter Sells for $399,000 A letter written aboard the Titanic by Colonel Archibald Gracie, one of the ship’s most notable survivors, has shattered records by selling for $399,000 at auction, far exceeding its original $75,000 estimate. . Penned on April 10, 1912, the day Gracie boarded, the letter reflects his and was successfully sent during Titanic’s final stop at Queenstown, Ireland, before later reaching its recipient in London. Just hours before the sinking, Gracie played squash, swam in the ship’s pool, attended a church service, and mingled with fellow passengers. # [Lord Byron’s daughter Ada Lovelace was the first computer programmer.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfbi4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Science & Industry](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfbi4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfbi4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| L ong before laptops and smartphones, a 19th-century Englishwoman named [Ada Lovelace](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfbi4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) created what many consider to be the world’s first computer program. Lovelace was born in 1815 to famed poet Lord Byron and philanthropist Annabella Milbanke Byron, though she never had a relationship with her father and was raised alone by her mother. Annabella became fearful that Ada would inherit her artistic father’s perceived “insanity,” and so she encouraged Ada to study grounded disciplines such as logic and math. Lovelace grew fond of those pursuits, and developed a keen interest in the inventions of English mathematician Charles Babbage, whom she met in 1833. Babbage told Lovelace of his plan to create a complex calculating machine known as the Analytical Engine — the precursor to the modern computer — and Lovelace was eager to contribute to the project.
---
In 1843, Lovelace was asked to translate a French account of one of Babbage’s lectures overseas, and Babbage encouraged her to expand the paper with her own thoughts. In August of that year, Lovelace published the 66-page translation, which included 41 pages of appendices containing additional theories and formulas. The most famous of these notations is “Note G,” which has been deemed the world’s first computer program. In this table, Lovelace determined how the machine could theoretically calculate a sequence of rational numbers known as Bernoulli numbers. Though the machine was never built, and thus was never able to successfully execute Lovelace’s calculations, the theory laid the groundwork for the future of computer programming.

## The oldest known analog computer was discovered in an ancient Greek shipwreck.
The [Antikythera mechanism](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfbi4&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) is an ancient device built between 205 and 60 BCE that sank to the bottom of the Mediterranean aboard a shipwreck in the first century BCE. The corroded remains were recovered in 1901, though the mechanism broke into three pieces upon its removal from the water. Given the advanced wear, it wasn’t until 1905 that the relic was first theorized to be some sort of ancient analog computer. Teams examined the series of complex dials and gears, which were operated by turning a small crank. As research progressed, it was determined that the Antikythera was used to calculate astronomical positions of the sun, moon, and planets; users could enter a past or future date and turn the crank to make astronomical predictions. This discovery sent shock waves through the scientific community, which previously believed this technology hadn’t been invented until the 14th century.

clean_body: Long before laptops and smartphones, a 19th-century Englishwoman named Ada Lovelace created what many consider to be the world’s first computer program. | L ong before laptops and smartphones, a 19th-century Englishwoman named created what many consider to be the world’s first computer program. Lovelace was born in 1815 to famed poet Lord Byron and philanthropist Annabella Milbanke Byron, though she never had a relationship with her father and was raised alone by her mother. Annabella became fearful that Ada would inherit her artistic father’s perceived “insanity,” and so she encouraged Ada to study grounded disciplines such as logic and math. Lovelace grew fond of those pursuits, and developed a keen interest in the inventions of English mathematician Charles Babbage, whom she met in 1833. Babbage told Lovelace of his plan to create a complex calculating machine known as the Analytical Engine — the precursor to the modern computer — and Lovelace was eager to contribute to the project. In 1843, Lovelace was asked to translate a French account of one of Babbage’s lectures overseas, and Babbage encouraged her to expand the paper with her own thoughts. In August of that year, Lovelace published the 66-page translation, which included 41 pages of appendices containing additional theories and formulas. The most famous of these notations is “Note G,” which has been deemed the world’s first computer program. In this table, Lovelace determined how the machine could theoretically calculate a sequence of rational numbers known as Bernoulli numbers. Though the machine was never built, and thus was never able to successfully execute Lovelace’s calculations, the theory laid the groundwork for the future of computer programming. | By clicking a link in this email, you're agreeing to our and . The is an ancient device built between 205 and 60 BCE that sank to the bottom of the Mediterranean aboard a shipwreck in the first century BCE. The corroded remains were recovered in 1901, though the mechanism broke into three pieces upon its removal from the water. Given the advanced wear, it wasn’t until 1905 that the relic was first theorized to be some sort of ancient analog computer. Teams examined the series of complex dials and gears, which were operated by turning a small crank. As research progressed, it was determined that the Antikythera was used to calculate astronomical positions of the sun, moon, and planets; users could enter a past or future date and turn the crank to make astronomical predictions. This discovery sent shock waves through the scientific community, which previously believed this technology hadn’t been invented until the 14th century. ## Cowboys, Texans NFL Draft Highlights
The Dallas Cowboys and Houston Texans each [added nine players to their rosters](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb8Gd0b2YAwpXGxDl223RAMeg1eDiWwrJH__lPzCq690dM_5d5_vGDmm7S8e5OornHOiqzDVSnlOgX3GUPe47Ry3vZYD_5-ZaQYFvVRGwjh7jPyejfBuUf6mBTk9mH7sRq2t2F3Xj3agxULnadA3o62yAYNRBvUyrFZE94EpA6PWSvd9ewOzeAUEfsE1rF1jFPlYz9zWnSq9sAR-n0_K7Xoegt1e66M03Z8Gpgam67raFPizNTB9ZBqYvndTYPnVkSEmZFkSPuSW0VOR4cwSmWUHshIeRWTnH1dkjsUOjVHbgfHLFPV3lZ4OfgIAAP__OHp77A) during last week's NFL Draft, aiming to plug holes and land long-term playmakers. The Cowboys selected [Alabama offensive lineman Tyler Booker](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupDAMRb8mdEFJCI9MkWIburftlshgJ2RlyBPJDMPfr5hf2MZyYR3fc_98T9-QOO3xN2zk6zvkaaezMNVKx7QHxgNCXVNcOcW1lg3-5oNpMsr0Ullp3ISQ-Jpsg35W-NANeT3Y3nVO669m9cGiCy6EZcAHLkhK0UIOu14NQ68AmuRvmLLGaa1037cPY2dUhgzOsISlE1YRppqPtq5U6Q0l8JVfdLRL3hr2a60_RXS_hBmFGc_zbGfOMaY91pXmfJX7TpjxfiPMaO91uIe12hndCTOGtAPLj9QeWH6kZTwAqUgEZihyyefNkvMzMaY9SpDzk_lqDo8_Z2JO5WsQVsUNEn-S1f_r8-XNvwAAAP__67yKAw) with the 12th overall pick to replace retiring guard Zack Martin. Their second and third round picks--Boston College pass rusher Donovan Ezeiruaku and East Carolina cornerback Shavon Revel Jr.--were both expected to go earlier. The Houston Texans selected two wide receivers in their first three picks--Jayden Higgins and Jaylin Noel, both from Iowa State. They'll add [depth to a receiving corps](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD3u4yAQR0-DO0cwBocUFNu4y7ZbWtgMNqsxRDCbj9uvnCv8uylG7-n9_tznu0-U8vbbH-j4Hcuc8dUImbHOOVKoPvKetp3StnM7_N9SCWeQYHqpe7Bz8Ik-s-6CW2S4qQ6dumpjB6vU2O1utdLc_Gis1SZIMLAO16glLmZEZcfYJXfCpAarlFTGXG6glyABISx-jesgtMSQuNQL78j49i3SpzyxXtZydOR25kcTwy8Bk4CJfONXqaHk9iiV2_kkYMqRBEynScAk9XmPAqa9_Gtccn9ic-u_WTlS_83ut-oDNgFTV114vBJRauNVaLkdPtFXzz8b7engfwAAAP__5DN_rA) led by Nico Collins. The Texans also added Minnesota offensive tackle Aireontae Ersery, bolstering an offensive line that was one of the worst in the league last year and was [left with a gaping hole](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L3ypCAQBPCnwQwLRlw1ILjEbC-90BplEO5GsYDaj7e_2n2Ff97V9ev-c1_uGDme-288yNaXT8tJz8JUK-Xl9Owy-hriHjjuoZYD_6bMtICCXiojYVwcRn4vpnF2VW7SDVk9mH7sRq1vTbBm8IpGmpRTG-DqPJlpgK330-Bdj2MT7adMGRi1Vrrv2wnM6hQQuBU3v3XCKHKxptzWQJVeWDy_04Nyu6WjYRtqvYrofgmYBczlSrmW9o0hpU9AwHx6FjBjrnFjEjB_8adn-R0nr7j9KxJPJ_eMjor0KUtklh3ISngUqRQMulNqakM9uMnWXc_IHMttEEbtB0b-WurPHnxY-B8AAP__-kGFfQ) after veteran Laremy Tunsil was traded to the Washington Commanders.
## Megachurch Leaders Accused of Power Grab
Members of Houston's Second Baptist Church have filed a lawsuit accusing church leaders of [secretly changing the organization's bylaws](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL_upCAURp8GOw1ccZSCYhu72XZLg_wRNlcxcB1n3n4z-wq_9vuSk5Pz57k8TcJ0bL_N7jW9Q14Of1f0RL4sR0BXTKCYtohpi1R38zcX9AtwGFouW5gWZxJ-Ftk4vXKnROO1GOUw9ZMQjyZqAUMPvQ1OCR9GkMHK0YzGOdWrB6yqSfoL4xImIbgYhk6BXB0HD241NtieSe5dolw6ip7829SAn_zypbN5b1BHorOy_heDmcF833dnY8nH92Uw2wvpKp7BXDymLeWDwWwKJYvfMearUj7a6m0-XLuak1Kl1sar2NiiueuVqAUOSioYujOeTdHuvBNiqo-RSb7tJuF_FfpZwJeGfwEAAP__FtSHDg) so that they could seize control of its assets, which exceed $1 billion. Last May, Ed Young resigned as pastor of the 94,000-member, six-campus megachurch after 46 years leading the community, appointing his son Ben Young as his successor. Before he stepped down, however, he helped orchestrate revisions to the bylaws that allegedly [denied members the right to vote](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAQhp_G7oiAkNhbUFzjbq-90hpgMHMamwgmm_Xbn3KvsPUv_fq-78_n-gnEdGy_YUcv37muB746owi29cicGmQptBWmrUjf4W9tjKvV9qa0U3ZeExCfqxuTDzp9mBG9mdxtvs7G3MfijZkxYJ4BrYNgIcYp5XuYrjqjm1wYyb_PtLOzMdrcbpcP60LSFm0KEHO8Dk5jIqntIgUFv6FnPusXtkus-8i-iDz6cP012GWwS4CHUJe3xXsf7AJNKDIOdin12aUeiuHVnySKugIlwKhqVg_oUhuw6s8YsXeqh9pxg1ieLRb1QmApCo6kMuzEp0rnAV3OwS5j8-nxImbq92lwetuB-D-d_Kzpl7f_AgAA__-Vh5Do) on a new pastor. The [lawsuit claims](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL8GMo-MYRgICC6ZbC-9EDV2g3vVYNRumOXvTzO_sGGppFK99-9r_AJi2pa_sOKgP3MaN3xlRlWUcZs5CMwaaYlMS9S8wncSxtFZdze2Ma4bAxBfY1OGYbKhr0ocqkdz7-quqtoyDnNfT48JK3x0CHXroZk7WweYfOv7vsWShveYbVxXVba632-9a6ZgHbowgZ99XTQWA2mSm0ZU_IE885VOlJtPa8lDVN1zUf8p3LNwz--DCSVd-d0W7snwygep2SWttOGmJqYja9qMj4f4aAJ63JVO5MsIrunEYFZcJ5RszqS0LUY-7Gah8512yJrEbAjClwnkFTQJARs4NCYhvQr3LGUI-4uYKbePorHLCsSfx_o7z-fg_gcAAP__Tb2aDQ) that though the changes were ostensibly intended to clarify the church's beliefs on contentious cultural issues, the real objective was to ensure family succession and consolidate "power and control over church governance and church assets." The day after Ben Young was installed as the church's pastor, he reportedly ordered his father to "cease his involvement in the church" and fired the headmaster of the church's K-12 school.

What is Project 2025? You kind of know. But what is it really?
That's the question David A. Graham of the Atlantic set out to answer in his punchy new book, "The Project: How Project 2025 is Reshaping America" which comes out next week. I interviewed David for the [podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/d53befba-830c-4bc2-8c20-9077d78dd9a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
"You probably haven't read Project 2025 because it's a 900-page document with 70 different authors," David notes. Project 2025 was produced under the auspices of the Heritage Foundation, a fifty-year old conservative thinktank.
You likely remember Donald Trump disavowing any familiarity with Project 2025 during last year's election. David laughs at the distinction. "Three-quarters of the authors and contributors worked in the first Trump administration, four of them at the Cabinet level." After he won the election, Trump appointed many of its contributors to top positions, including as border czar, CIA director, chair of the SEC, and head of the Office of Management and Budget. Bloomberg found that 37 of the first 47 executive actions taken in Trump's first few days directly or partially matched Project 2025's recommendations.
So what's in Project 2025? "It's a detailed policy platform, a huge database of potential administration hires, training courses for aspiring staffers, and a playbook for a takeover of government." David describes it as a skeleton key for understanding the second Trump presidency.
"In his first term, Trump had a hiring problem," David relates. "This time, they wanted to have a deep bench of true believers ready and willing to occupy and operate agencies across the board."
This might be the biggest thing to understand about Project 2025; there's a saying in government that personnel is policy. Here, Project 2025 identified the personnel ahead of time so they could hit the ground running and ensure that they made progress on their agenda. Its foreword argues, "Conservatives have just two years and one shot to get this right."
So what is the agenda? David says, "Project 2025 is opposed to what it sees as an obstinate bureaucracy. So its agenda is largely to massively expand the power of the president. The principals involved want Trump to be able to stock the executive branch with political appointees; to fire civil servants at will; to discard the historical impartiality of the Justice Department; to attack the statutory independence of agencies like the FCC and to seize powers of Congress for the president." This does seem like a pretty good summary of the first 100 days.
So let's say that power is successfully concentrated in the hands of the executive branch. What would they want to use it for? The authors of Project 2025 are right-wing conservative ideologues with a worldview. On families, they want to ban abortion nationwide and promote a traditional arrangement where women are at home and men are working. On immigration, the authors want to reduce immigration, both legal and otherwise, of any category. Student visas, work visas, H-1B visas, they want them all to either be much smaller or be eliminated entirely. They think the Department of Education should cease to exist and have any funds or authority sent to the states. It's kind of a retro, go-back-in-time agenda.
The Project's perspective on trade is interestingly divided. "Both pro-tariff protectionist arguments are presented as well as pro-free trade points-of-view. It's as if they were divided on this item so they just included them both." They want to reduce taxes on the super wealthy and on big corporations and replace it with a consumption tax that would be regressive. They are negative on safety net programs, and think that the poor should be cared for by religious organizations and philanthropy. They are hostile to the Federal Reserve.
David notes that the authors' response to what they see as the centralization of power of the government is, perversely, the further concentration of power in the hands of the President. In the same vein, their response to what they see as the politicization of various agencies is further politicization. "For many of them, Trump is a vessel to achieve an agenda. Trump may support aspects of it, but they have a vision that they want to implement and see Trump as a way to do it."
Project 2025 is unusual in its digging into government itself trying to change how it functions. "Even now, the changes they are making to how government works will have an impact on our way of life for years, even decades to come." He's not wrong, and David's summarizing of the Project gives a very useful roadmap of what the future holds. It's not pretty. Ideologues tend to make bad rulers. That these guys have taken power is an ugly indictment of our current political system.
For David's book, click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/6567263d-a9b3-4ac4-959f-39fd8f2783b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). For my podcast interview with David, click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/d53befba-830c-4bc2-8c20-9077d78dd9a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). To see what Forward is doing in your state, click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/c46bfd58-b3d6-4228-94bc-c49066be1345?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); maybe we need a Project 2029. It should be shorter than 900 pages.

name: Conservative combat veteran serving Montana in Congress
subject: I gave it all up to serve, and I don’t regret a thing.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Troy Downing for Congress
body:
Career politicians are getting rich off your hard work. I’m here to stop them.

| | | [](https://trk.emails.troydowning._ucdIf32cQ)
---
Hi, Peter, this is Troy Downing, a conservative freshman Congressman.

I bet you're as disgusted as I am by all of these swamp rats in Congress whose salary is a little over $100K per year, but their net worth skyrockets to millions of dollars after they get elected.

President Donald Trump did the exact opposite. He was already a billionaire and took a massive pay cut to serve our country. Believe it or not, I'm not too different. I was in the private sector, living a successful life. But after 9/11, I enlisted in the United States Air Force to serve my country. I gave up a lot of career opportunities and even risked my life, but it was worth every second and every dime.

**Now, I'm doing the same thing in Congress. I didn't come here to make millions. I set millions aside so I could serve people like you who are sick and tired of the corruption, fraud, waste, and abuse that's happening at the hands of these thieves in pressed suits.**

Right now, Republicans hold a slight majority in Congress. If we don't keep it, we can expect more of the same corruption to plague our country (_and our pocketbooks_) in the coming years.

However, if we manage to hold the line and defend our position in Congress, we can put an end to the backroom deals, the insider trading, and the self-serving policies that have lined the pockets of career politicians while hardworking Americans suffer.

I can’t do this alone, so I’m sending this email to your inbox today. I need strong conservatives like you to stand with me. **[**Will you chip in a few bucks to help us fight back and keep America first?**](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)**
---
[ **DONATE TODAY** ](https://trk.emails.troydowning.)
---
I know it’s not easy, so I understand if you can’t contribute today. But if you can, time is running out, and we need every Patriot on board. Tap the link above to donate and help us drain the Swamp once and for all.

Let’s take our country back,
---
---
Troy Downing (MT-2)

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgu2efs3603ca5nd31dd5nv9rnp6rgs4kq7bj4j8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3imeo71c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zk5ii82g5psnf39t5o97srqgv2rhduofokihpkeg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3imeo71c9h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.

Then I got to Congress and saw firsthand just how corrupt and broken our government really is, and let me tell you, one of the biggest hurdles we face in our movement to save America is the U.S. Senate.
**The worst of them is Jon Ossoff, or as I like to call him, radical transgender activist Jon Ossoff.**

**_That’s right... Jon Ossoff can’t raise money without using MY NAME._**
**He is obviously terrified of me running for Senate... So maybe that’s exactly what needs to happen???**
Friend: Before anything further happens... I need to know if I should run for Senate in Georgia, and if I do, I need to know if I will have your support or not...
This would be the biggest fight of my life. The most important. The most brutal. And the most high-stakes. **The radical Left, the fake news media, the RINOs, the globalist billionaires** – they would ALL come after me with everything they’ve got...

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkoogj0mgm1o2lco7l2s38p88l7bap0knjno0sc0_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3im1pr1cph2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zb2f8t5dk1acggpk3gb4k4q4vd3ck6i37c3vqd00_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3im1pr1cph2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.

GOP Rep. Tom Emmer**[fired back at CNN's Dana Bash](https://substack.com/redirect/18fb360a-66ee-4da3-a425-63559f87252e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**, during a tense interview about "due process" in the deportation of Kilmar Abrego Garcia, with the perfect comeback that put the issue to rest once and for all.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/18fb360a-66ee-4da3-a425-63559f87252e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/18fb360a-66ee-4da3-a425-63559f87252e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"There's no evidence that was provided because there was no hearing to do so that he is either a murderer or a criminal or a gang member," Bash said. "Isn't that something that should be provided to a judge, even an immigration judge,..."
"Actually I think he was afforded that due process," Emmer clarified. "You have a citizen of El Salvador that is within the country of El Salvador, it really isn't the U.S.'s ability to remove someone, it will be up to the President of El Salvador."
Emmer reiterated that Abrego Garcia did in fact receive due process when he requested asylum and he was rejected on the basis of the Department of Homeland Security's allegation that he was a gang member.
"I find it very interesting that **[your network and the senator from Maryland are doubling down](https://substack.com/redirect/18fb360a-66ee-4da3-a425-63559f87252e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on an illegal alien when they won't talk about all the Americans who have been harmed by illegal aliens! You've heard this story over and over about Rachel Morin, the senator's own constituent, he doesn't even give words of comfort to her family but he will fly down to El Salvador to deal with an illegal alien!"
After the knockout blow from Emmer, Bash pivoted quickly to the topic of Trump saying he would consider deporting American citizens to El Salvador.
Emmer refused to play her game of damning hypotheticals. Watch what happens next:
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/18fb360a-66ee-4da3-a425-63559f87252e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# White House Displays Mugshot-Style Posters of Arrested Migrants
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7322609c-adec-4aae-8207-902aa319d6ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
On Monday, the White House lawn featured a striking display of mugshot-style posters showcasing 100 illegal migrants arrested by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) during President Trump's first 100 days in office. The placards, marked with "ARRESTED" in bold, included photos of the migrants alongside their alleged crimes, such as first-degree murder, sexual abuse of a child, kidnapping and rape, murder, rape of a child, and distribution of fentanyl. Each poster bore the official White House logo at the bottom.
"White House lawn looks a little different this AM," Trump administration spokesperson Kaelan Dorr **[said in an X post](https://substack.com/redirect/2ddd9dd4-d31e-4128-9f75-a7fc84a47175?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. "And they say yard signs don't win elections..."
According to a White House official, the posters were strategically placed along the White House driveway, a location commonly used by news outlets for live shots, to ensure maximum visibility and media coverage. The display aims to highlight some of the most serious offenders apprehended by ICE, emphasizing the administration's focus on immigration enforcement.
"The dishonest media--who are hellbent on supporting criminals and illegal aliens are forced to walk by these yard signs reminding them that President Trump is putting America first and American's safety first," wrote former Arizona senate candidate Kari Lake.

subject: Help me take back our libraries
body:
Before you do anything else today, will you please take a moment to sponsor a gift for our “See You at the Library Day” in the next 48 hours?

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7rnsca0hb0bc2kosngaecsem38n8pva05j931u8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hm8ob0c3h2bs)

| | Fellow Conservative,Before you do anything else today, will you please take a moment to **[sponsor a gift for our “See You at the Library Day” in the next 48 hours?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zlitamf8skv9turjeloqe6g7mpsjkg7nomq5kir8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hm8ob0c3h2bs)** If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed.The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.”Radical librarians call _Adventure of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” _Little House_ series.And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for...”

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zsjbiqctl5dva311ankcro8c4egpfaorob71ah40_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hm8ob0c3h2bs)
---
| | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family – for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!**[**I hope you see why I need your help today.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3el85vd8509ho5hl56mad9vgn30cfelrniiqtf0_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hm8ob0c3h2bs)** My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named **Brave Books** , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. Our idea was to read the classic books you and I grew up with plus new wholesome **Brave Books** that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected our request to host our Story Hour. >> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep us out including booking all the event rooms for themselves.>> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), **Brave Books** was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” our supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile.In the end we got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those Story Hours where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America,” and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible.But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking **Brave Books** how they could host Story Hours of their own.And that’s how our nationwide “See You at the Library Day” was born. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 360 libraries in 45 states.On the same day, we held hundreds of Story Hours to fill children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.**I went to as many "See You at the Library" events as I could in one day to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots...**...for a very simple mission – to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries.And this year, our ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to over 1,000 libraries reaching over 100,000 children.The exact date in August will soon be announced. And before then, what we need is you!It’s going to be expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold Story Hours for 100+ children at each library – that's 100,000+ children in all. **[That’s why I hope you’ll give a sponsorship gift of $175, $350, $525 or more today.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z05i2birl3fnrlnaf11hu647pr1kh7cg26lq5pdo_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hm8ob0c3h2bs)** Your sponsorship gift will be used to send a “Story Hour Kit” to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library Day” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for the little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items.**Brave Books** is a small Christian company. They don’t have the millions behind them like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA.Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our 1,000 Story Hours to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. Knowing that, **[**please consider a sponsorship gift of $175.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5gf3434rlm0pj26r3rvfkdh2qikblqhu111396g_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hm8ob0c3h2bs)** That’s enough to sponsor one entire “Story Hour Kit” yourself. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. **[Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $175, or anything higher or lower please get your sponsorship gift in within the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we can get into this August!](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8j7u8tis8vlp59ioq7kgkqh0n0rco92a2igh3dg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hm8ob0c3h2bs)**

Be forewarned: I'm about to employ every nerdy, fact-obsessed facet of my advanced degrees in geography to dispel notions of Maryland being included in the cultural or geographical American South.
As a geographer, the placement of Maryland in the metaphorical "American South" has always puzzled and annoyed me.
Perhaps my obnoxiously stringent attention to facts and details makes this one of my biggest pet peeves among niche issues in my field. Or maybe it's the advanced degrees in geography. Or that I've lived in three northern (PA, NY and MD) and three southern states (MS, LA, FL) for extended period of times.
The topic seems to be floating around again as nihilists imagine a new Civil War.
Thus I am providing a thorough academic review of why Maryland _**is not**_ part of the American South -- through a series of analysis and maps.
We'll start with the physical Earth aspects (global positioning, climate, flora and fauna) and move into history, culture and politics.
_I received an alert that I 've embedded too many maps and this post is too long to be sent entirely by email, so if you're reading this through email, be sure to click through and read the full post on the Substack site._
* * *
## Geographical Considerations
When discussing states by the attributes of "north" and "south," geography should be the first (and I would argue definitive) consideration. We'll address the cultural north and south a bit later, but let's start with the planetary north and south first.
#### Latitude
If you divide the eastern seaboard exactly in the middle from the southern-most point to the northern-most point, you would split the country at the border of Virginia and North Carolina.
Southern-most point: 25 degrees South (Florida)
Northern-most point: 47 degrees North (Maine)
Exact center: 36 degrees north (near the VA-NC border)
If you do the same thing across the entire continental US, and not just the eastern seaboard, the line barely moves because the northern-most point would be 49 degrees North in Washington state.

Throughout May’s career, she has worked tirelessly to amplify the voices of women, Asian Americans, and others who are too often unheard. Now, she has her sights set on shaping, influencing, and transforming policies in her state.

**Her opponent, the Republican incumbent Delegate David Owen, passed zero bills during the 2025 legislative session and an independent analysis by the Virginia Public Access Project found him to be the _least effective legislator in Virginia._**

**He has said he would like to see abortion become illegal in Virginia and has repeatedly voted against commonsense gun safety policies, paid medical leave, bills to raise the minimum wage, lower prescription drug costs, and more...**

In the House of Delegates, May, on the other hand, will defend a woman’s right to make decisions about her body, including abortion, contraception, and IVF. She also vows to protect healthcare providers, ensuring they can offer these services without fear.

**Here’s why this district is important:** Kamala Harris carried this district by 9.4 percentage points in 2024, and Susanna Gibson lost by only 715 votes in 2023. This is a prime flip opportunity, but to make that happen, May needs our help.

[**We have a real (and rare) chance to unseat an anti-choice Republican man who hasn’t done anything useful for his constituents and replace him with a qualified, pro-_women_ woman who will defend our rights. subject: Help me take back our libraries
body:
Before you do anything else today, will you please take a moment to sponsor a gift for our “See You at the Library Day” in the next 48 hours?

| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z1jchl8uuhc35fafjlqatevc2t1igm76s0l3ke10_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hmcoj6c9h2bs)

| | Fellow Conservative,Before you do anything else today, will you please take a moment to **[sponsor a gift for our “See You at the Library Day” in the next 48 hours?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zaja6vt8dtk8hua379s28fombsehe9jkvvag612o_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hmcoj6c9h2bs)** If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed.The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.”Radical librarians call _Adventure of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” _Little House_ series.And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for...”

---
| | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family – for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!**[**I hope you see why I need your help today.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ziov8jhlr61hhenv0l96qes451m9h62f78dau520_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hmcoj6c9h2bs)** My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named **Brave Books** , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. Our idea was to read the classic books you and I grew up with plus new wholesome **Brave Books** that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit.>> Over 50 libraries rejected our request to host our Story Hour. >> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep us out including booking all the event rooms for themselves.>> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), **Brave Books** was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” our supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile.In the end we got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those Story Hours where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America,” and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible.But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking **Brave Books** how they could host Story Hours of their own.And that’s how our nationwide “See You at the Library Day” was born. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 360 libraries in 45 states.On the same day, we held hundreds of Story Hours to fill children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.**I went to as many "See You at the Library" events as I could in one day to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots...**...for a very simple mission – to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries.And this year, our ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to over 1,000 libraries reaching over 100,000 children.The exact date in August will soon be announced. And before then, what we need is you!It’s going to be expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold Story Hours for 100+ children at each library – that's 100,000+ children in all. **[That’s why I hope you’ll give a sponsorship gift of $175, $350, $525 or more today.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zq0blssrsdauad5fnk079h49co6ans4ogbps75e8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hmcoj6c9h2bs)** Your sponsorship gift will be used to send a “Story Hour Kit” to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library Day” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for the little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items.**Brave Books** is a small Christian company. They don’t have the millions behind them like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA.Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our 1,000 Story Hours to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. Knowing that, **[**please consider a sponsorship gift of $175.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z2ihemc47679r70jemgirccloasn74n9tjkh9pk8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hmcoj6c9h2bs)** That’s enough to sponsor one entire “Story Hour Kit” yourself. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. **[Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $175, or anything higher or lower please get your sponsorship gift in within the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we can get into this August!](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zs9qfa634tcun1j9f5urjj3d9v0ff1tqse8cha98_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c3hmcoj6c9h2bs)**

Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family – for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named Brave Books , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile.In the end we got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those Story Hours where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America,” and read wholesome and Godly books.It was incredible.But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking Brave Books how they could host Story Hours of their own.And that’s how our nationwide “See You at the Library Day” was born. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 360 libraries in 45 states.On the same day, we held hundreds of Story Hours to fill children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.I went to as many "See You at the Library" events as I could in one day to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots......for a very simple mission – to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries.And this year, our ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to over 1,000 libraries reaching over 100,000 children.The exact date in August will soon be announced. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for the little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items.Brave Books is a small Christian company. name: Jon Ossoff
subject: On authoritarianism
body:
MAGA is committed to eliminating Democratic seats in Congress so Trump can continue his “revolution” without domestic opposition.
---
Derek, _Our new reality —_ From classrooms to boardrooms to local governments and the press, Americans now fear political retribution from their own government. Think of the CEO who bends the knee after public threats of prosecution. Or the newspaper owner who decides it’s safer to bury editorial criticism of the president. The president and his lieutenants relish the power of intimidation. _And they’re using it._ *** Before my election to represent Georgia in the U.S. Senate, I led investigations of corruption and human rights abuses worldwide. More and more, the atmosphere under Trump reminds me of countries where dissent is silenced by intimidation. _“We don’t want any trouble.” “We’re not sticking our necks out right now.” “We don’t need an investigation.”_ **These things should never be said in the United States.** *** Derek: Only by regaining Congressional power can we reverse this. Remember: In 2026, I’m the only Democratic U.S. senator up for reelection in a state Trump won. MAGA needs me defeated and gone. _**Help me defeat them in a landslide. Peter,

Working as an FBI special agent was my dream job. But when I became an agent, I swore an oath to protect and defend the United States Constitution against all enemies -- both foreign and domestic.

When I discovered the FBI's National Security Branch had refocused counterterrorism from legitimate foreign actors to political opponents within our borders, I knew I had to say something.

In August 2022, I made protected whistleblower disclosures about my concerns regarding the January 6th investigations assigned to my office.

**My whistleblowing was apolitical and in the spirit of upholding my oath._However, it nearly cost me everything._**

Thanks to the Kash Foundation, I was able to stand up to the Deep State and expose their efforts to villainize patriots. The Kash Foundation offers legal and financial help to whistleblowers, veterans, and American patriots who come forward with evidence against the Deep State's actions.

To thank him for his efforts, I told Kash Patel that I would help him raise $20,000 before the end of the week to help the Kash Foundation take on the Deep State.

I was a special agent for the Federal Bureau of Investigation for eight and a half years. During that time, I investigated approximately 200 violent crimes, such as aggravated assaults, murder, child abuse, rape, robbery, child molestation, child pornography, and human trafficking.

“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights.
That's exactly why we need to tell the Senate loud and clear: REJECT the anti-voter SAVE Act! Add your name today >> [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-the-senate-reject-the-anti-voter-save-act-2?source=041625swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.everyaction.com%2F9bivrSvjFEim0QMMvgcQrA2]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-the-senate-reject-the-anti-voter-save-act-2?source=041625swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.everyaction.com%2F9bivrSvjFEim0QMMvgcQrA2]
Voter Action Project [https://secure.everyaction.com/Qyv_-_BiF0iduOUt5sZ0yw2?am=25.00&contactdata=5RodzEALjE6NZ2/XPQ3DaQeJhvLp1lob4U+ir0XEqWDJkyj/rsQEJlCfREFUD5B4AgziWacZpuj1NbgJi0LVfxpo38X1ErZwyept8hNIMe4=]
Folks -- Every eligible American deserves the freedom to vote without jumping through impossible hoops.
The SAVE Act would scare newly naturalized citizens out of voting and make it harder for millions of eligible voters to cast a ballot – especially seniors, women, students, veterans, and rural voters.
The House of Representatives has passed the SAVE Act – a cruel, calculated attack on every American’s right to vote. The Senate must REJECT the anti-voter SAVE Act and protect our right to vote.
We’ve all seen what happens when voting rights are stripped away. People lose their voice, communities lose power, and elections no longer belong to We The People – they belong to those who make the rules.
Add your name to our petition urging the Senate to REJECT the SAVE Act >> [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-the-senate-reject-the-anti-voter-save-act-2?source=041625swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.everyaction.com%2F9bivrSvjFEim0QMMvgcQrA2]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-the-senate-reject-the-anti-voter-save-act-2?source=041625swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.everyaction.com%2F9bivrSvjFEim0QMMvgcQrA2]
It’s designed to effectively block millions of eligible Americans from casting a ballot – especially women, seniors, students, and rural voters.
Here’s how the “SAVE” Act puts your vote at risk: [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/save-the-usps-3/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.everyaction.com%2F9bivrSvjFEim0QMMvgcQrA2]
* Prove your citizenship – again: Even if you’re a lifelong voter, if you move across town, change your last name when getting married, or switch parties, you’d have to provide your passport or birth certificate with your current legal name – in person at your local elections office – just to stay registered.
* Get stuck in long lines: Election officials would face impossible workloads, causing confusion and delays.
* Lose your right to vote – without warning: If outdated records can’t verify your status, you could be purged from the rolls without even knowing it.
We still have time to pressure the Senate to stop this – but only if we speak out NOW.
Let’s show the Senate just how many of us are paying attention and demanding they protect our freedom to vote. Sign on today! >> [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-the-senate-reject-the-anti-voter-save-act-2?source=041625swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.everyaction.com%2F9bivrSvjFEim0QMMvgcQrA2]
