name: Ryan Busse
subject: I worked in the firearms industry for more than 25 years. Now, I’m working with Gabby Giffords to fight for decency and responsibility.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I’ve had enough.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-apr25.x-ZdIQ&refcode=em250428-1-b&t=1&akid=10358%2E3935704%2Ej3JZbX)
---
Team,
My name is Ryan Busse. For more than 25 years, I worked as a firearms executive who helped build one of the world’s most iconic gun companies.
When I first started, the gun industry was a different place. It was a place where people like me could still advocate for responsibility and decency.
But over time, I saw firsthand how the gun lobby changed. It gave up its values to stoke fear and extremism. The NRA entertained dangerous conspiracy theories — including attempts to undermine our democracy.
I had enough. Now, I am working alongside GIFFORDS to hold the gun industry accountable and help save our country.
[**Before I share more, can you make a donation to help GIFFORDS PAC continue their fight? Their April fundraising deadline is just 2 days away.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-apr25.x-ZdIQ&refcode=em250428-1-b&t=2&akid=10358%2E3935704%2Ej3JZbX)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-apr25.x-ZdIQ&refcode=em250428-1-b&t=3&akid=10358%2E3935704%2Ej3JZbX)**
Growing up on a ranch, my dad taught me to shoot at a young age. He instilled in me both a love of shooting and a deep sense of responsibility. I still shoot and hunt with my own boys any chance I get and I believe in our rights.
The way I use guns hasn’t changed. What has changed is the NRA.
The NRA was founded to teach firearm safety and promote hunter education. It’s given all that up.
Now, it’s a tool for extremists to push their agenda and undermine even the most basic and common sense regulations like background checks. They spend millions of dollars every year lobbying lawmakers to bend to their will — even though a majority of gun-owning Americans support these same commonsense solutions.
This isn’t okay, and it doesn’t have to be this way.
**Since leaving the industry, I have joined forces with Gabby Giffords to continue our fight back against the radicalization of the gun lobby.**
GIFFORDS has worked to build a national coalition of grassroots supporters committed to advancing commonsense gun safety laws. And with your support, we can continue countering the NRA’s lies.
[**If you’re able, please contribute $10 or more to power GIFFORDS PAC’s work. Grassroots support makes a big difference in this work, and our fight cannot wait.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-apr25.x-ZdIQ&refcode=em250428-1-b&t=4&akid=10358%2E3935704%2Ej3JZbX)

**This issue is beatable!**
1) Turnout for the **May 6th PRIMARY ELECTION** is expected to be around 5% of registered Ohio voters. That's about 400,000 total votes.
2) The past 2 times a similar bond issue was on the ballot, the winning margin was 19.23%, let's round that up to 20%. That means 60% YES & 40% NO. Or, 240,000 YES votes & 160,000 NO votes. A 20% difference or 80,000 vote differential.
3) **FIRST** , if we can educate 10% of the potential YES voters & turn them to NO voters, the result would be 216,000 YES votes & 184,000 NO votes, a 24,000 vote swing. Across Ohio's 88 counties we'd need to persuade 273 YES voters to vote NO, **A VERY REASONABLE** thing to do.
4) **SECOND** , if we can activate 40,000 voters who typically don't vote in primary elections **and get them to vote** , that's a turnout increase of only 0.5%, or one-half of one percent! This is also **A VERY REASONABLE** thing for us to try to get done! It's only an additional 455 votes per county.
5) **WHEN** we do this, **WE WIN!** The final vote count would be 224,000 NO and 216,000 YES = 440,000 total votes = 5.5% turnout. Again, **A****VERY REASONABLE** objective!
**WHAT EACH OF US CAN DO TO SPREAD THE WORD AND MAKE THIS HAPPEN!**
Over the next week, **PLEASE** :

name: Restoring Integrity & Trust in Elections
subject: RITE DEFENDS VOTER ID LAW IN IDAHO
body:
RITE has filed an amicus brief in the Ninth Circuit supporting the constitutionality of Idaho’s recently enacted voter identification laws |
---
| |
---
| | **RITE DEFENDS VOTER ID LAW IN IDAHO**
(Washington DC – April 28, 2025) – Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (RITE) has [filed an amicus](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=7f000242a8&e=ea91f782ea) brief in the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit supporting the constitutionality of Idaho’s recently enacted voter identification laws.

The case challenges Idaho’s 2023 legislation removing student IDs as an acceptable form of identification for voting. RITE filed in support of Idaho Secretary of State Phil McGrane, arguing that the state’s updated voter ID requirements are not only constitutionally sound, but also a reasonable and necessary measure to protect the integrity of the ballot box.

Idaho’s law continues to allow multiple secure forms of ID—including free, state-issued identification—and applies uniformly to voters of all ages. As RITE’s brief explains, the removal of student IDs, which often lack consistent security features, is a legitimate step to ensure that only qualified voters cast ballots, and does not constitute age-based discrimination under the Twenty-Sixth Amendment.

“Idaho’s voter ID law treats every voter equally, regardless of age, and helps ensure the state has uniform procedures to verify the identity of Idahoan voters,” said RITE spokesman Tim Murtaugh. “The Constitution guarantees the right to vote—not the right to demand election processes designed around a specific group’s preferences. States have every right to strengthen election security with uniform, age-neutral rules like Idaho has done here.”
###

[1]Justice Democrats

The day has come, Peter: Today,
Justice Democrats is officially announcing our first 2026 primary
challenger of the cycle: State Representative Donavan McKinney in
Michigan’s 13th district!

Donavan just launched his grassroots campaign against a self-funded
multimillionaire incumbent, and we need to show he’s got people power
behind him in these crucial first 24 hours.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250428-1-dm?refcode=em20250428-36611&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36611_1203867_h7ccv_&akid=36611%2E1203867%2Eh7ccv_ ]Will you become a Day 1 founding donor by pitching in any amount now?
100% of your donation will go directly to supporting Donavan’s campaign.

This is Justice Democrats’ first new primary candidate in a few years, and
it’s a race that embodies our fight to transform the future of the
Democratic Party.

We’re really proud to back Donavan. He’s a working-class progressive and
lifelong Detroiter who’s ready to take on corporate-backed, out-of-touch
multimillionaire Shri Thanedar and win.

Unlike his incumbent opponent, Donavan is truly always with the people:

He has served as a State Representative for Michigan’s 11th House
District since 2023 — the poorest district in the state with a median
income of less than $20,000. While there, he has fought hard for his
district, helping to secure tens of millions of dollars for public
schools, community recreation centers, Community Violence Interruption
programs, and clean water for Detroit and its suburbs.

He has been a champion for environmental justice, workers' rights, and
labor unions — powering crucial work at the state’s largest healthcare
union, SEIU Healthcare Michigan, and spearheading crucial climate work
for clean air & water and a sustainable future in Michigan at Climate
Power. In January 2020, he also made history with his appointment to
Michigan’s first Environmental Justice Council by Governor Gretchen
Whitmer, where he was instrumental in Gov. Whitmer’s Water Restart
Program and her statewide Water Reconnection Executive Order during the
COVID-19 pandemic.

He has lived the most pressing problems his community faces. He grew up
poor in northeast Detroit, but his mother and grandmother provided him
with all that he needed: love, family, and the importance of community.
Their guidance led Donavan toward becoming the community leader and
public servant he is today. Growing up, he experienced eviction and
homelessness, has seen his mom work multiple jobs to feed her family,
and has the same asthmatic cough his mother, grandmother, and brother
have from toxic, polluted air.

Millionaires like incumbent Rep. Shri Thanedar don’t fight for us in
Washington because they don’t understand our problems. People are fed up
with a Democratic Party overrun by do-nothing politicians who are unfit to
lead the fight for working people in this moment.

Donavan represents the future the Democratic Party should be fighting for:
working-class people taking our power back from the ultra-wealthy to
deliver for everyday people.

Who we send to fight for us matters. And it’s time the Mighty 13th
District sends someone to Congress who fights with the urgency our current
crises demand and has a vision bold enough to match the scale of those
crises.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250428-1-dm?refcode=em20250428-36611&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36611_1203867_h7ccv_&akid=36611%2E1203867%2Eh7ccv_ ]Let’s get to work making it happen in MI-13. Rush $5 or
anything you can to help us get to our goal of $50,000 and kick Donavan’s
campaign off strong on Day 1!

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250428-1-dm?refcode=em20250428-36611&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36611_1203867_h7ccv_&akid=36611%2E1203867%2Eh7ccv_ ]Contribute $5

This race is only the beginning. Let’s go!

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas

Peter,

Congress is like a battlefield—thrilling, mission-driven, and full of conflict. At least no one’s shooting at us here. Well, not with guns, anyway.

The out-of-touch fake news “reporters” at Politico decided they would target the most dangerous men in DC: Navy SEALs.

We all ran for office because we were still hungry to protect and fight for our country. The war may be over for us, but we can’t abandon the part of our lives that made us who we are. We were part of an elite unit on the front lines, and Congress is somewhere else we can be out front doing something special for our country.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d0c0a2c0-e966-408f-88c1-da304c3e7b2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Owyhee County Sheriff Larry Kendrick ([@KendrickSheriff](https://substack.com/redirect/a4fc4b8b-ef84-49a7-8baa-4b45d7311661?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) GETS IT...

He's stepping up, [enrolling in ICE's 287(g) program to enforce immigration law and protect Idaho](https://substack.com/redirect/4afe5f64-bd6b-4f3a-8f36-14deea7739cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Meanwhile, some folks in the Idaho legislature are _undermining the people 's will. _
For example...
Representative [@DaleHawkinsID](https://substack.com/redirect/7308de2f-bee4-459c-b3fa-4c5416d1b8b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and drafted a bill to mandate 287(g) for every county in Idaho. We had [President Trump's clear directive to deport illegals](https://substack.com/redirect/cfc4214c-b683-4b04-becc-604891c1d72f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [a (weak) executive order from Governor Little](https://substack.com/redirect/de830d96-1d51-4bc0-821c-1c5442536c28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Yet, the bill gained no ground in the House.
Why?
Because some establishment Republicans and their allies are beholden to corporate interests and open-border advocates who profit from illegal labor. It's not just 287(g).
[My bill to mandate E-Verify](https://substack.com/redirect/f51c0756-ce7a-4917-a8dc-69c84c6d7f35?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (with Rep. [@redmanforidaho](https://substack.com/redirect/244871f5-02d4-4e79-9759-09019139479e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) that prevents illegals from taking jobs (H252) got ZERO HEARING in the House. [A bill sponsored by myself and Rep. Hawkins criminalizing the harboring of illegals](https://substack.com/redirect/690ca0fa-5ca8-423f-a66e-820aa827e47a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and other measures to secure Idaho (H335) was killed in a committee dominated by REPUBLICANS.
The reason is clear...
## _**There are those in the Idaho legislature who prioritize Big Agriculture and globalist agendas over Idaho 's sovereignty. **_
Some don't even HIDE IT (and [some have their farms raided by ICE](https://substack.com/redirect/690ca0fa-5ca8-423f-a66e-820aa827e47a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and employ dangerous violent criminals). They're enabling lawlessness while illegals overrun our state while pretending to "do something" about it with watered down bills.
Like House Bill 83, a half-hearted attempt at immigration enforcement, is a prime example of the Idaho Legislature's failure to fully commit to securing our state. While it passed the House 61-9 and the Senate 29-6 in 2025, this bill is a watered-down compromise that barely scratches the surface of what's needed.
It was a "feel good bill" that didn't actually... do anything (see my debate on this in the video [posted here](https://substack.com/redirect/d8a40916-d39c-48eb-8296-7fdd2bb6eb98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d8a40916-d39c-48eb-8296-7fdd2bb6eb98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It allows law enforcement to check immigration status only when someone is already detained or investigated for another crime, slapping a misdemeanor for "illegal entry" on first offense and a felony for a second, with deportation as a consequence.
_**This is a toothless gesture, deliberately narrow to avoid stepping on the toes of Big Ag and the open-border crowd.**_
How do I know?
[Because the Idaho Dairymen and others SUPPORTED the bill](https://substack.com/redirect/b763db3a-1a56-4fc7-ad66-32b6cb9249ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)!!
The bill's sponsors claim it supports President Trump's deportation agenda, but it fails to empower police to proactively root out illegals and leaves gaping loopholes for employers who exploit cheap labor. Worse, the courts have already kneecapped it. [The ACLU of Idaho, predictably, filed a lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/8a83e30b-79dd-458e-b20b-42e60e511a83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the moment Governor Brad Little signed it into law on March 27, 2025, whining about "racial profiling" and "unconstitutionality."
U.S. District Judge Amanda Brailsford issued a temporary restraining order that same day, blocking the law's enforcement, and extended the block on April 14, 2025, while she considers a preliminary injunction. House Bill 83's weakness made it an easy target; a bolder law with teeth might have stood a chance.
_**The legislature 's willingness to be RUN BY BIG AG LOBBY GROUPS are why we're stuck in this mess.**_
_Can you believe it?_
In a state DOMINATED by Republicans, we still act like Dems in this area (and others). Crazy, right? It's time to clean house in 2026 and replace every single enabler of this chaos with leaders who will fight for Idaho.
Because we're bringing ALL THESE BILLS BACK and I'm gonna die on this hill every single time.
_**Borders, language, and culture determine our destiny.**_

subject: [READ HERE] Why the Tariffs Are Good
body:

Yes, you read that right: there _is_ something good about tariffs.

Not because they help the economy. They don't. In fact, tariffs...
* are a tax on American consumers and businesses,
* raise the price of everything we build, grow, and use, and
* make life harder for individuals and businesses.

But their backfiring is doing something we desperately need.

It's waking people up.

**Recent polling shows that 58% of Americans now oppose tariffs. Even more striking: 64% of young Americans — the very people we’re trying to reach — reject tariffs entirely.**

This is a powerful “teaching moment,” and that's where FEE steps in.

At the Foundation for Economic Education, we believe these economic lessons shouldn't come from hardship. We should be equipping young people to understand why tariffs fail — before they experience the fallout.

And that’s what we do through our **FEE in the Classroom** program.

We teach students about the awe-inspiring power of free-market economics, how protectionism ultimately harms a country’s effort to protect itself, and how reduced barriers to trade raise global prosperity.

And when students learn these truths? **They don't forget them.**
_**“I learned a lot about how trading works and how happiness increases when there is a wider trading pool!”**_
— High School Student, FEE in the Classroom program (April 2025)
[You can help FEE provide an inspirational economics education to more students. Click here to take action >>](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j81unDAUhZ_G7ED42vzMgkVaNKlStWqbVVfRxb5k3GKbsQ3T6dNHIDQ76_N3dc5BO09mvHes-cQALkZHBsDEEwO4_r7ZsPyxX5_zl2_lS36tv9tq-4XPh7rCQ3YKf60_Xkk8f8H49B9fr7X8ufKHnu4zPeQjtCCLZtpo02e6E6MuZUYdb2TVVo2o2uzSYdUqLk7tSVWKJA5iaMe2wQpBnCSAzkwHJVSlhJbXAEIWXIimQSA9cFm3ijNZ7jkFWgpGIY_phiF4bwvlbTZ1l5TmuBc7MzhHUkugAh1pnzaDwXn0i9OYjHf56ENOyjtvjcpJL2rH292Qo9rf4rwk-6bQzmjeHRP9Vq8UDOqNW9JmsUz0gdZ4wUAHTxQ2egv8ANEvQRETfRwOorxL5BITfaJ_6W0y7i_PQqfnm5kmE-uGyfJ9n7oNWzv4CAAA__8cuZYT)
[Donate](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0FvnDAQhX-NuYHw2IAvHNKiTZWqVduceooGe8i6wjZrG1bpr49AaG_W52_03kO3zHb66Fn3hQFcrUkMgIknBnD7e3dx_ee-P5cvP-qX8tb-dM3-C19PdYOH7DX-2X69knj-hunpP77eWvl74w89fyz0kM_QihzaeafdUJheTKaWBfW8k41qOtGo4tojKiVHmmrB5aSU5iN0nPMRRlCcw1TYHmpoagmKtwBCVlyIrkMgM3LZKs2ZrI-cCh1Fq5GnfMcYQ3CVDq6Y-2vOSzqKXRhcEuk1UoWeTMi7weAyhdUbzDb4cgqxJB18cFaXZFZ94P1uLFEfb3FZs3vT6Ba0756JYa9XCwbtzh0ZuzomhkhbumKkk2eKO71HfoIU1qiJiSGNJ9HBZ_KZicEEj5nexjXn4HkRe7Pc7Tzb1HZM1u_H3H3c1sNnAAAA__8rBJdr)
In short, free trade ultimately benefits the United States. Because of the backfiring of tariffs, Americans are reminded of that simple truth.

**The tariffs have brought a consensus among Americans that free international trade _with no restrictions_ is a net gain for their nation, just as for the world.**

**Throughout history, free global trade has exponentially raised the standards of living, reduced conflict, fostered diplomacy, caused immense scientific and social progress, and brought billions from the depths of poverty into the arms of prosperity.**

**When nations trade with nations, when individuals trade with individuals, it is a basic economic truth that both parties benefit. When this voluntary trade is allowed to flourish over time, the progress is astronomical. It’s as simple as that.**

_...but many young people aren’t aware of this._

Many students who attend our FEE in the Classroom program tell us they are unfamiliar with free market economic concepts and this monumental story of progress.

**But once we educate them, they become lifetime advocates for tried-and-true free market principles.**

FEE is trying to reach more students, but I need your help.

These workshops are free to schools, but not free to run. That’s why I’m asking:

clean_body: | | Patriot, Yes, you read that right: there is something good about tariffs. Not because they help the economy. They don't. In fact, tariffs... are a tax on American consumers and businesses, raise the price of everything we build, grow, and use, and make life harder for individuals and businesses. But their backfiring is doing something we desperately need. It's waking people up. Recent polling shows that 58% of Americans now oppose tariffs. Even more striking: 64% of young Americans — the very people we’re trying to reach — reject tariffs entirely. This is a powerful “teaching moment,” and that's where FEE steps in. At the Foundation for Economic Education, we believe these economic lessons shouldn't come from hardship. We should be equipping young people to understand why tariffs fail — before they experience the fallout. And that’s what we do through our FEE in the Classroom program. We teach students about the awe-inspiring power of free-market economics, how protectionism ultimately harms a country’s effort to protect itself, and how reduced barriers to trade raise global prosperity. And when students learn these truths? They don't forget them. “I learned a lot about how trading works and how happiness increases when there is a wider trading pool!” — High School Student, FEE in the Classroom program (April 2025) In short, free trade ultimately benefits the United States. Because of the backfiring of tariffs, Americans are reminded of that simple truth. The tariffs have brought a consensus among Americans that free international trade with no restrictions is a net gain for their nation, just as for the world. Throughout history, free global trade has exponentially raised the standards of living, reduced conflict, fostered diplomacy, caused immense scientific and social progress, and brought billions from the depths of poverty into the arms of prosperity. When nations trade with nations, when individuals trade with individuals, it is a basic economic truth that both parties benefit. When this voluntary trade is allowed to flourish over time, the progress is astronomical. It’s as simple as that. ...but many young people aren’t aware of this. Many students who attend our FEE in the Classroom program tell us they are unfamiliar with free market economic concepts and this monumental story of progress. But once we educate them, they become lifetime advocates for tried-and-true free market principles. FEE is trying to reach more students, but I need your help. These workshops are free to schools, but not free to run. That’s why I’m asking: Thank you for helping us change the hearts and minds of the next generation toward freedom. In liberty, Diogo Costa President P.S. FEE in the Classroom educational workshops teach youth about concepts and principles of liberty like entrepreneurship, private property, individual liberty, and limited government. Our network of acclaimed professors and accomplished entrepreneurs educates students about the economic, ethical, and legal principles of a free society. Each year, we reach tens of thousands of students through this program, and we want to reach tens of thousands more. But we can’t do it without you. FEE is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit educational organization, so donations made to FEE are tax-deductible to the full extent allowable by law.

Dear Peter, As utility bills spike and heat waves, wildfires, and extreme weather grow more intense, Oregonians are left less resilient, healthy, and safe. We must act in the short term to get utility rate hikes under control, and in the long term to help people make upgrades to homes and buildings that lower bills, improve energy efficiency, and make our communities safer. To make this a reality, we’re hosting face-to-face meetings with _your_ lawmakers in _their_ offices in Salem, next month!

Join OLCV and our partners for the [**Building Resilience Lobby Day**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106668215/542259096/1508761705?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVhNzlmYjA4LTRlMjQtZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ikoot23LoWzn_B3zOqSc4M6LwfC2Jd8iFj1Aq5OWWg0=&emci=5bb6cb07-4a24-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=5a79fb08-4e24-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=2107230)**at the State Capitol on Wednesday, May 7**. Together, we’ll talk to legislators in Salem and push for bold action on climate, energy-efficient housing, and energy justice.

Our Lobby Day will connect you with lawmakers to make policy personal. **Building Resilience Community Lobby Day****WHEN: Wednesday, May 7 from 9AM - 5PM**
**WHERE:** Oregon State Capitol, Salem→ [RSVP by Wednesday, April 30](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106668218/542259099/1508761705?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVhNzlmYjA4LTRlMjQtZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ikoot23LoWzn_B3zOqSc4M6LwfC2Jd8iFj1Aq5OWWg0=&emci=5bb6cb07-4a24-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=5a79fb08-4e24-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=2107230) ← Lunch and Breakfast Provided **We’ll set up the meetings** , provide training and talking points, and partner you with others in your district for conversations with your lawmakers. Join us, alongside [Building Resilience](https://click.everyaction.com/k/106668219/542259100/-1480106498?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVhNzlmYjA4LTRlMjQtZjAxMS04YjNkLTYwNDViZGVkOGNjYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ikoot23LoWzn_B3zOqSc4M6LwfC2Jd8iFj1Aq5OWWg0=&emci=5bb6cb07-4a24-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&emdi=5a79fb08-4e24-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=2107230), to make the case for:
* **One Stop Shop 2.0**(HB 3081) to help people find, apply for, and benefit from home energy rebates with live local support.
* **Get the Junk Out of Rates**(SB 88) so things like expensive lawyers, lobbyists, and advertising fees come out of utility company profits and not our pockets.
* **Full Funding For Current Programs**(state budget) like Community Resilience Hubs and heat pump incentive programs – especially for renters, rural households, and communities hit hardest by the climate crisis. These programs are nearly out of funding and are proven to improve health, cut climate pollution, and help people stay housed by lowering the cost of living.

We’ll keep this one quick, team.
You might already know about the voter suppression bill that Trump and his cronies have been trying to get passed. The deceptively named **Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act (SAVE Act)** would prevent millions of people from registering to vote.
People who don’t have passports, married women who have changed their last names, and anyone without immediate access to their birth certificate could lose their right to vote.
**The SAVE Act passed in the House earlier this month. Now it's up to the Senate to protect voting rights for EVERYONE once and for all.**
[We need a wave of voting rights activists to take a stand to defend our rights and democracy. We know that our candidates can do it, Peter. EMILYs List women won some of the toughest House races in 2024: Reps. Janelle Bynum (OR-05) and Laura Gillen (NY-04) flipped red seats, unseating MAGA extremists; Reps. Emilia Sykes (OH-13) and Susie Lee (NV-03) won reelection in Trump districts, holding their ground in some of the toughest races of the cycle; and Rep. Kristen McDonald Rivet (MI-08) won her Trump+2 district by seven points. But it's not going to be easy. Trump and his Republican cronies are once again ready to pour millions of dollars into critical House races, funded by billionaire backers like Elon Musk. They want to buy their way into power, roll back our rights, and control our bodies. We can't let them get away with it. 🔗 [New Hampshire Public Universities Face Scrutiny Over Admission of Undocumented Students](https://link.emails.granitesolutions.-yUQ/s7j4736f2ef)

I filed a Right-to-Know request to demand full transparency, and I will keep fighting to ensure fairness for our families — especially for middle- and working-class Granite Staters who depend on affordable, in-state college options.

| | It is an honor to represent the 2nd District. Our shared values – working hard, caring for each other, and serving the community – guide my work in Congress. My role as your representative is to work for you, listen to your concerns, and stand up against the Republican Rip-Off. **This month, I met with Snohomish County leaders to discuss Northwest Washington's transportation needs.** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106671522/542265447/1363731251?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MWZmNGQzNi01MjI0LWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aPkv6mXyB8Ln37X1zsDcxS_Xc8Ilr9TW6F1WsnwRnuo=&emci=e2f30791-2b21-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=91ff4d36-5224-f011-8b3d-6045bded8cca&ceid=9494239)** As the lead Democrat on the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, I am beginning work to reauthorize federal surface transportation programs. clean_body: My priority is to protect Northwest Washington, listen to your concerns, and stand up against the Republican Rip-Off. | | | | It is an honor to represent the 2nd District. Our shared values – working hard, caring for each other, and serving the community – guide my work in Congress. My role as your representative is to work for you, listen to your concerns, and stand up against the Republican Rip-Off. This month, I met with Snohomish County leaders to discuss Northwest Washington's transportation needs. As the lead Democrat on the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, I am beginning work to reauthorize federal surface transportation programs. I am proud to have brought $386 million from the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to the 2nd District to revitalize our community and create jobs. Thanks to the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, every day is infrastructure day in Snohomish County. My meeting with Snohomish County leaders will help guide our work for the 2026-2031 transportation budget. This month, I also stopped by the Anacortes Senior Activity Center to discuss Medicaid and Medicare and listen to your concerns. The Energy and Commerce Committee has jurisdiction over the Medicaid program, and they have been tasked with making $880 billion in budget cuts over 10 years. Many of our friends and neighbors in Northwest Washington rely on Medicaid for health care access, and I am concerned about how these cuts are going to impact our community. Please continue to send personal stories to my office, so I can continue to advocate and fight for the program. name: Lt. Col. Alex Vindman, USA, Ret.
subject: Donald Trump’s “peace deal” will only lead to more war...
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
He’s embracing the same predatory posture that led to two world wars and hundreds of thousands of dead Americans.
#
Peter, Alex Vindman here.
Donald Trump and JD Vance are demanding Ukraine take their most recent “peace deal” or they will cut and run. So, let’s get into it. What’s in this deal?
Formal recognition of Russian control in Crimea. Formal recognition of Russian control of virtually all occupied Ukrainian territory. Forbidding Ukraine from joining NATO. Lifting all sanctions imposed on Russia since their illegal occupation of Crimea. Forging new economic ties between the U.S. and Russia.
This is the same extortion scheme Trump tried and I reported him for, resulting in the first impeachment — a demand Zelenskyy do what Trump wants or Ukraine is cut off.
This “peace deal” is Russia’s deal, maximum pain for Ukraine and maximum reward for Russia. It abandons Ukraine and Europe and is a gift to Russia. It sends a clear message to the world’s tyrants: They can invade, terrorize, murder, and be rewarded rather than punished for it.
I wrote the Crimea Declaration in Trump’s first term when I worked on the National Security Council, which made it the position of the United States to recognize Crimea as Ukrainian land and reject Russia’s illegal occupation. Trump 2.0, now completely unchecked, abandons it. He’s embracing the same predatory posture that led to two world wars and hundreds of thousands of dead Americans.
Trump and Putin share that predatory world view, and it won’t make America wealthier. It won’t make us safer. It will make the world a more dangerous place and put American troops at risk.
I refuse to stand by as Trump takes us down this path, and I’m proud to work with VoteVets as they hold him accountable and combat his administration.
[**Can you add your name and say that you’re with us? Millions of Americans still stand with Ukraine, and speaking together in one voice sends a powerful message to Trump, Putin, and the entire world.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/250425_ukraine/?source=em250428-1-120&akid=34379%2E3013755%2E9w95Ez)
| [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.votevets.org/signup/250425_ukraine/?refcode=em250428-1-120&akid=34379%2E3013755%2E9w95Ez)
---
Thank you for your help on this.
Lt. Col. Alexander Vindman
U.S. Army, Ret.

name: Team Kaptur
subject: A disaster for voting rights
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/95655/images/kaptur-email-header-2.png]

Friend,

Earlier this month, Marcy stood up for voting rights by voting against the SAVE Act, a GOP bill that has the potential to disenfranchise tens of millions of legal voters.

Under this disastrous legislation, online and by-mail voter registration would be impossible, and many married women whose names have changed would lose the right to vote unless they could provide original copies of their birth certificates and marriage paperwork.

This bill would gut our constitutional right to vote. Voting by non-citizens is already a federal crime, and the data shows it almost never occurs.

But that hasn't stopped GOP dark-money groups from coming after Marcy. They're already running new attack ads with lies and smears about Marcy's voting record.

Team, we need your support to fight back. Can you chip in $10 or whatever you can spare to defend our district? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kaptur25_em?refcode=250428_team_SAVE_l1]

Chip in → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kaptur25_em?refcode=250428_team_SAVE_b1]— Team Kaptur

About Marcy Kaptur
Marcy Kaptur is a fighter for high-wage jobs, growing a workforce to meet the needs of the 21st century, and protecting our region’s most vital natural resource, the Great Lakes. She’s worked with both parties to secure investments in our communities and has been a true friend of veterans, seniors, first responders and working people. She’s a voice for us all in the People’s House.

body:

---

| | | | A couple of weeks ago, Lizzie reminded us that everyone on this team has a role to play in standing up to the Trump administration’s far-right extremism that’s hurting everyday Americans and putting vulnerable communities at risk. A lot of that fight is playing out in the courts—and it’s going to stay that way. Lawyers and advocates have already filed hundreds of cases challenging the Trump administration’s cruel, unconstitutional actions. And there are more to come. This isn’t a short-term battle. | ** _After 185 Years, Eliza is Coming Home!_**
---
| Elizabeth “Eliza” Kortright Monroe Hay, the eldest daughter of President James Monroe,passed away in Paris, France in 1840, destitute. After nearly two centuries, a wrong willbe righted, and the truth will be told about this daughter of an American President andFounder. Eliza's remains will be exhumed from Père-Lachaise Cemetery in Paris andbrought to America for reinterment with her family members in the President JamesMonroe plot in Hollywood Cemetery, Richmond, Virginia in the fall of 2025. Several years ago, a Virginia woman visiting Paris sought out Eliza's grave only to find itovergrown and in disrepair. She and others have visited and maintained the gravesite tokeep it from being declared abandoned. They decided it was time to bring Eliza home.The Bringing Eliza Home Project, founded by Barbara VornDick, has been working fornearly two years with Eliza descendants and Père Lachaise, and has just obtained finalapproval from Paris to bring Eliza's remains home. The team of Virginia ladies has beentraveling around the state giving presentations and raising the funds needed for thishistoric repatriation. Mrs. VornDick has been interviewed for radio, podcast, and newsarticles as far north as Philadelphia. As Monroe historical interpreter Beau Robbins putit, “This is the most significant historical repatriation since John Paul Jones.”
---
| | |
---
| Image courtesy of Historic Fredericksburg Foundation, Inc.
---
| Mrs. VornDick, Eliza's first biographer (Eliza's True Story), spent five years researchingEliza. When she learned the truth of Eliza's situation at her death, she knew thatbringing her home to Virginia was the right thing to do. Eliza was an American citizenand daughter of a U.S. President and Founder; she often carried out the duties of FirstLady during the eight years of Monroe's presidency due to her mother's poor health;and she nursed the sick of Washington, D.C. during two epidemics. The U.S. Embassy in Paris has played a pivotal role in moving the repatriation forward,and the campaign is currently supported by many organizations including JamesMonroe's Highland, The James Monroe Museum and Memorial Library, the JamesMonroe Memorial Foundation, the National Societies of the Sons of the AmericanRevolution and the Daughters of the American Revolution, the Daughters of 1812, andmany citizens who have donated to the cause. My senior advisor, Chris Snider, has worked to assist with this effort though my office aswell as while serving on Congressman Bob Good's staff. I was very pleased to receivethe news from Barbara and Chris that Eliza will be reunited with her family this yearhere in Virginia. Coincidentally, today is her father's 263 rd birthday! Happy Birthday,President Monroe!
---

alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Peter,
Each year, the Massachusetts Democratic Party gathers to celebrate the bold leadership and enduring spirit of our Democratic champions. We're thrilled to invite you to one of our most cherished traditions — the 2025 Roosevelt Awards Dinner .
This year, we proudly present Franklin and Eleanor Roosevelt Awards to:
* Lieutenant Governor Kim Driscoll

* Singer, Songwriter, and Activist James Taylor
Named for two of our nation’s most inspiring leaders, the Franklin and Eleanor Roosevelt Award is our Party’s highest honor. Their legacy of courage, compassion, and commitment to progress continues to guide us today.
Past Roosevelt Award recipients include Democratic giants like Senator Ted Kennedy, Secretary John Kerry, Senator Elizabeth Warren, Governor Deval Patrick, and Governor Maura Healey — a true testament to the impact this recognition represents.
We are also proud to present:

### The Walls Are Closing In--And It's No Longer Just in His Head
Donald Trump is spiraling [faster than a one of his taxpayer-funded golf carts on a wet lawn](https://substack.com/redirect/f2cb5bbc-9e24-48e6-b98e-1491754f7000?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [it's glorious to watch](https://substack.com/redirect/db7dcb82-f89b-4471-8ae6-4dfc77066d94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Poll after poll is dropping like anvils on his bloated ego, showing him at **historic lows not seen in 80 years** --and that's _with_ an entire right-wing media apparatus or liars and scoundrels at places like Newsmax and The Heritage Foundation still fluffing his MyPillow.
His approval ratings--[WaPo has him at 39%!](https://substack.com/redirect/9c7b00c7-3751-40fb-a95d-39e3830c3050?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--are now backstroking somewhere between "shark attack" and "airplane food." And true to Trump form, he's reacting like a toddler denied him his third Happy Meal: whining, flailing, and flooding Truth Social with a Category 5 tantrum (he may have sharpied this one, too).
Yes, he wants to investigate the pollsters. Ya know, [like any normal person ](https://substack.com/redirect/58168158-ca16-4726-b498-53baabaad8cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)would.
The guy who claimed to be "the most popular president ever" is supported by only one third of independents, **down 10% among white voters w/out a college degree** and has bled support among seniors. It's almost like--as WE predicted--firing his voters from their government jobs because it gives Elon a woody, [crashing their 401ks](https://substack.com/redirect/1af1f8ee-8a91-4a02-898a-5cbc47768642?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and bankrupting their farms, ranches and businesses by [disappearing their labor force](https://substack.com/redirect/4a3be093-3e25-4edf-b914-26a67441c984?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (and sometimes relatives) to the Hotel San Salvador isn't smart?
Could this be why he's now trying to [illegally stop Democrats from fundraising](https://substack.com/redirect/757c8124-09a9-4e28-9f4a-bfb41bdbc8d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
**Even Fox News Is Packing the Lifeboats**
And if you thought Trump's meltdown was funny, wait until you see his reaction to **[Fox News putting down the pom-poms](https://substack.com/redirect/351daf2c-3c6a-471e-80c0-48058796b8c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ just for a moment](https://substack.com/redirect/351daf2c-3c6a-471e-80c0-48058796b8c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and reporting, _gasp_ , that his economy's a **disaster** and his Ukraine policy looks more like Putin puppetry than foreign policy. When Fox anchors start sounding like Rachel Maddow in how they see your dingy, whimsical, baby-formula-based plans to self-destruct America, you know the wheels have officially fallen off.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/347009f9-529f-4650-a923-dedb3b51a11b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Trump's economic "strategy"--blow up supply chains, raise the price of labor, tax American businesses and people with[ deranged tariffs](https://substack.com/redirect/4edfe52d-9343-428c-98ff-1e910c03105e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [tank the stock market](https://substack.com/redirect/de590d88-894c-40e9-a202-8043952a1635?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--has all aged about as well as a ketchup-sloshed, Trump Steak left on a Mar-a-Bed Bug porche in August. And with Trump responding to Putin's sociopathic bombing of children in Kiev by screeching "Vladimir Stop," like he's a sixth grader whose BFF just asked his crush to the prom dance, well, these are reasons he may just be losing some people.
So even Rupert Murdoch's minions--at least at the moment--are gingerly backing away. No wonder Trump is sobbing into his Diet Coke at Mar-a-Bed Bug--**the only thing sinking faster than his poll numbers is the loyalty of the people who once chanted the spray-painted animal balloon 's name.**

body:
Peter,

Since Donald Trump took office in January, Keith has organized or participated in nearly a dozen town halls across Minnesota—hearing directly from the people most impacted by Trump’s attacks on our rights and freedoms.

As the People’s Lawyer, Keith isn’t just listening. He’s giving a platform to veterans, trans folks, teachers, and everyone else being targeted by the Trump administration and fighting back.

And it’s working, Peter. The lawsuits Keith is filing have already forced the Trump administration to pause or abandon some of its most reckless and illegal plans.

It’s our job to keep this campaign on track so Keith can focus on challenging Trump in court. That’s why we’re reaching out: We’re just a few days away from our end-of-month deadline, and we still need to raise $12,450.

According to our records, you’re still eligible for Minnesota’s Political Contribution Refund (PCR) program. That means you can donate up to $75 (or $150 for couples) and receive a full refund from the State of Minnesota.

Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106677540/542283445/-292812465?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20250428_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MjdmMTk0Yy01YjI0LWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d4CEAtYuPC0jbKbjSMY0SNGOXZ8jOrF91LxMC-CNNLE=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106677543/542283451/-292812465?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20250428_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MjdmMTk0Yy01YjI0LWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=d4CEAtYuPC0jbKbjSMY0SNGOXZ8jOrF91LxMC-CNNLE=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the threat of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

But we have something they don’t, Peter: A powerful grassroots movement made up of working people, not faceless corporations. | | Folks, **Alabama’s congressional map is at stake in a federal trial** that wil decide if the state will keep the new court-created district that led to the election of a second Black representative. From the AP: "_A three-judge panel will decide whether congressional lines drawn by state lawmakers diluted the voting power of Black residents. The same panel already ruled against Alabama in pre-trial decisions that reshaped the 2nd Congressional District before Rep. Shomari Figures won election in November, giving Alabama two Black representatives in its delegation for the first time in history._ " **The state of Alabama is seeking to reinstate the maps created by the suppressive state legislature.** This case began in 2021 when Black voters and civil rights groups filed lawsuits over Alabama’s state-drawn congressional map they said disenfranchised Black voters. **[Team, we have to make sure voters everywhere know about this case to protect fair maps in court. subject: A brand-new poll shows that 34% of voters are undecided
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heartland Patriots (LucasKunce
body:
We’re running out of time to earn their support.
Peter, it’s Mikie.
I’ll make this as fast as I can.
A new Rutgers-Eagleton poll of our race is out — the first independent head-to-head poll of the primary election for Governor since January.
It shows that we continue to lead — **but that over _one-third_ of voters are still undecided.**
The math is clear. Winning over those undecided voters is key to winning this race.

name: Nikki Budzinski
subject: This would devastate our communities. I’m speaking out:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nikki for Congress
body:
Friend,

I recently concluded a district-wide tour – meeting folks at local hospitals and community health centers – highlighting one of the biggest threats they are facing right now: Medicaid cuts.

The truth is that Medicaid isn’t a luxury, it’s an essential means to care for countless communities across Central and Southern Illinois. No matter where you live, everyone should have access to affordable, quality care.

Unfortunately, not everyone sees it that way. And now, Medicaid is under increasing attack from Republicans in Congress. Led by President Trump, House Republicans passed a new tax bill that would require $880 billion in cuts to Medicaid. Instead of allocating that money to working families across America, they bookmarked it for massive tax breaks to billionaires and large corporations instead.

It’s shameful, and it’s exactly what I’m fighting against in Washington. Cutting Medicaid could mean the difference between life or death. That’s not a risk I’m ever willing to take. I’m not going to cut a deal on the backs of working families – not today, not tomorrow, not ever.

I’m continuing to make my voice heard and I won’t stop until Medicaid is fully protected.

Thank you,

Nikki

name: Team Jayapal
subject: Let’s build real power together on Sunday, May 4
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Due to high demand, we’re offering a Resistance Lab 2.0 workshop to dive even deeper.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20250428-4991-footer&t=1&akid=4991%2E420207%2EEUMOld)
Peter, the Resistance Lab is about building real power together and learning the most effective ways to counter democratic backsliding. We’re absolutely _thrilled_ that more than 20,000 people so far from over 38 states and even some other countries (!) have signed up to take our Resistance Lab 1.0 training.
Now, we’re ready to offer the next 2.0 training to dive even deeper. **You can join our first-ever Resistance Lab 2.0 Training on Sunday, May 4 from 11am — 12:30pm PDT.[Make sure to RSVP and reserve your spot today!](https://www.mobilize.us/pramilaforcongress/event/775578?source=em20250428-4991)**
**[RSVP for the Resistance Lab 2.0 Training](https://www.mobilize.us/pramilaforcongress/event/775578?source=em20250428-4991)**
In our first round of trainings, we heard from experts about the pillars of support that authoritarian leaders rely on, and how nonviolent movements emerge to challenge authoritarian leaders. And we only scratched the surface of the most effective tactics to fight back.
**Our 2.0 level training will go even further.** We’re going to dive deeper into the institutional pillars that are propping up the Trump administration's agenda. We’ll explore different ways to erode those institutional pillars of support and successful tactics already being used across the country. And we’ll have time for you to meet people around the country in smaller groups to explore actions we can launch together.
You can attend virtually from anywhere, and you can even **[sign up to host a house party with your friends and family to participate in the training together](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/49179?t=2&akid=4991%2E420207%2EEUMOld).** This allows you to get people in the room from your own neighborhood and be able to brainstorm ideas you can move forward together right there. If you sign up to host, a member of our team will reach out with all the tools and resources you need to be successful.
We are also continuing to offer our Resistance Lab 1.0 training — the next one will be June 1. **[You can sign up for that one here](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/49180?t=3&akid=4991%2E420207%2EEUMOld).**
Remember: Around the globe, people have fought back and won. Democratic nonviolent movements have kicked out authoritarians time and time again. **We can too.**
Dictators and authoritarians count on people’s helplessness in the face of repression. We won’t let that happen. We’re here to help educate about effective non-violent resistance frameworks, and to inspire hope and build community — and save our democracy.
**So Peter, don’t miss out.[Sign up to attend our first Resistance Lab 2.0 training on Sunday, May 4, and get ready to resist!](https://www.mobilize.us/pramilaforcongress/event/775578?source=em20250428-4991)**
In solidarity,
Team Jayapal
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20250428-4991-footer&t=4&refcode2=4991_420207_EUMOld&akid=4991%2E420207%2EEUMOld)**

name: Lt Col. Alea Nadeem
subject: I was kidnapped in Iraq as a child. Now, I’m running for Congress.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alea for Congress
body:
Here’s why.
Fellow American,
I was born in Toledo, Ohio.
When I was just 8 years old, I was kidnapped in Iraq by my father during a trip to visit his family.
**I spent four years living under Saddam Hussein’s brutal and repressive regime where women had no rights, speaking out could cost you your life, and my future wasn’t my own.**
I understand the sweetness of freedom because I know what it’s like to be deprived of it.
I’m Lieutenant Colonel Alea Nadeem, and ever since I returned to my family and my life in America at 12 years old, I’ve been fighting for freedom. Right out of high school, I joined the Air Force to defend our great country after 9/11, and now I’m running for Congress to continue my service and put America First. **[Will you chip in a donation to help me win this fight?](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=dbe0160e786a444bb969cfd5f38be3ee&_e=7_yHu21PpHmcaASbXF-4j47_ERX9kSvutN-bHbtVe5SJt1MkOFl2YYzC1Ne3vKnRJIP5dkgPWbiWAwktUb5X8xGGvu-GvmmYwd9diRoqG-Yo8Plc69M8CmqrGR4ckMwGMTXDli3C2s373VR4ZC-j0I0ngJx11PRqiG326fq40m03E7oU-nqUJ6jG6qNf-H3AjcqYVVvr8niAPg8ay8ISKEA0Q-uK7adWy6IUHqF4H1AqRK3bNHXgeh1SHOuFCvO6Jld9MvyMMDCrFQJe_EzRrs60L-ySoHFsAQ50LT6TNVT0SueJInrYXSPUoGlqQI9qFl-rl_-PCFaBjnr324M07FMC7C4M6kr3KOH8104rhCBNsbI63BRASQguJZ978Ch69xyPkjabOvzQ6IPQULBIFA%3D%3D)**

My story and my fight for freedom didn’t end when I was rescued at 12 years old.
Just a few years later, when I was a junior in high school, I watched in horror as our country was attacked on September 11, 2001.
It was at that moment that I decided I would serve and defend our country and honor the second chance at freedom America offered me.

A year later, I was in basic training, learning to become an Airman.

clean_body: Here’s why. Fellow American, I was born in Toledo, Ohio. When I was just 8 years old, I was kidnapped in Iraq by my father during a trip to visit his family. I spent four years living under Saddam Hussein’s brutal and repressive regime where women had no rights, speaking out could cost you your life, and my future wasn’t my own. I understand the sweetness of freedom because I know what it’s like to be deprived of it. I’m Lieutenant Colonel Alea Nadeem, and ever since I returned to my family and my life in America at 12 years old, I’ve been fighting for freedom. Right out of high school, I joined the Air Force to defend our great country after 9/11, and now I’m running for Congress to continue my service and put America First. My story and my fight for freedom didn’t end when I was rescued at 12 years old. Just a few years later, when I was a junior in high school, I watched in horror as our country was attacked on September 11, 2001. It was at that moment that I decided I would serve and defend our country and honor the second chance at freedom America offered me. So, I walked into an Air Force recruiting office and signed up for the job they told me deployed the most. A year later, I was in basic training, learning to become an Airman. Since then, I’ve spent my career in military intelligence, serving both active duty and in the Air Force Reserve. I’ve advised top military leaders, deployed to the Middle East, and used my experience to help America understand the culture and geopolitics of Iraq and Syria. I know from my experiences that freedom isn’t free. We need more America First leaders who will stand up, defend our values, and ensure that future generations have the same opportunities I had. body:
Since Trump’s chaotic tariff announcements, every campaign has seen a slowdown.
# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=1612%2E400544%2EXTgEuW)
I wanted to be sure you saw the message from my team yesterday, so I’ve forwarded it below.
The truth is, it’s not just our campaign’s fundraising that’s hit a slump. **Since Trump’s chaotic tariff announcements,_there’s been a big drop-off in grassroots fundraising:_**
[**__**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250428_1_eom?amount=5&refcode=em20250428-1612&refcode2=1612_400544_XTgEuW&akid=1612%2E400544%2EXTgEuW)
This graph shows all donations to every campaign in the country through ActBlue, and you can see that the slump coincides _directly_ with Trump’s tariff announcement.
These chaotic economic policies are a direct attack on New Mexico specifically, where a huge portion of our economy relies on trade.
And this unexpected downturn in grassroots fundraising hurts campaigns like ours that rely on grassroots contributions.
**So I know that not everyone is in a place to give right now, and that’s 100% ok.****[But if you are, please consider pitching in $5 or whatever you can to help us reach our goal of 20,000 donations before April is over.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250428_1_eom?amount=5&refcode=em20250428-1612&refcode2=1612_400544_XTgEuW&akid=1612%2E400544%2EXTgEuW)**

Together, we can change the game for New Mexico and build a state where every family can thrive.
Be fierce,
Deb

Subject: slump
We’re going to level with you: our grassroots fundraising has hit a slump.
**And with a GOP opponent entering this race for Governor of New Mexico, we need to catch up. That’s why we set a goal to bring in 20,000 donations before April ends.**
**[If your budget allows for it, can you pitch in $5 or any amount to help us reach our goal and get our fundraising back on track?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250428_1_eom?amount=5&refcode=em20250428-1612&refcode2=1612_400544_XTgEuW&akid=1612%2E400544%2EXTgEuW)**
Our campaign to elect Deb and win a better future for New Mexicans is powered by everyday people.
Which means when our fundraising slows down, so does our ability to fund our plan to hire staff, organize up and down our state, and run ads to push back against attacks.
We set this goal to get back on track – not just for April, but for everything that comes next.
**Deb’s running to change the game for New Mexico and build a state where every family has what they need to thrive. But she can’t do it alone.**
**[If you’re with her – if you believe in this campaign and what we’re fighting for – will you chip in $5 or any amount to help us hit our April goal?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250428_1_eom?amount=5&refcode=em20250428-1612&refcode2=1612_400544_XTgEuW&akid=1612%2E400544%2EXTgEuW)**

Team Deb

Friend, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 __and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY – but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. **Now, I'm grateful to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal on the 20th anniversary of this important event.** This year will be a remembrance like no other, as we commemorate the 80th anniversary of victory in World War II and the 250th birthdays of the U.S. Army, Navy, and Marine Corps. **[Friend, the National Memorial Day Parade is ENTIRELY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=2j207emmudeckusj8xlgouw9n65dozfz8f4114pwx67n46oynkq29scf5ilyvyd14ln0gyo7c8zlq4v47qji35uxyfaspyvbs057wzbtzwis1lqnr7oth3qnk3md2iubv851uba40hfwfzvrijeiildi28u53hvxggir4bnvjqqs3hkb0sj0we6h73wymmy23athvuvjxrioo2mljy7pyhb71oogl2b8yg0qjfd03yymnsy7cgrj31e1xuu7hy0foya8l5d1sbzpowiunecl23jc&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfzdr&__onlt=h)**
---
[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=2j207emmudeckusj8xlgouw9n65dozfz8f9g5yjnpkefbsseneus7k6ie8lxtzbeiqk057evczkpu80dne01l9d0hr5sg1cdgtwq8uwssqg7372cltl3pk2ia3a22g93otgwe610hkamzympq60ok5qq5chtm2k80jml95665feh5tnhz2pz4jtutgtas7l6agps6q4kgvmh18lq79frvzo06ctm5nwig75slmaee66814j26h4k25ogwdqxth5mdky0ovghhj0tjjpnwetr6spg&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfzdr&__onlt=h) [**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=2j207emmudeckusj8xlgouw9n65dozfz8frzm5t26dqomcwknyyg6rz0qwlwraawzgwlrf8hd38dynuqs527hpls40ytmsjg8klwiprr98dk4qd6vexaiedtq41p2dlt5dw41ypjd1v0tx1mhq7eln0i998fsmog6lbvpx0eq97m72b29zg9b2e5exqcy5onm090f9c03ybpcrzesjrtsqkfo4xbnwsx1wmv0dyxsbc5cf7iyhfl18jzw0ml449e7mvdbjkcn4pyv9g4fe7hmef8&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfzdr&__onlt=h) [](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=2j207emmudeckusj8xlgouw9n65dozfz8fxsqa0elvlgi0b4nsd84j340ilvpbzorm7kcqb7duv5cr01wu4pdu7hoy3tci4izsqdw8mq22bb5yry438mrzs244qa2bbgl19zn2cgy4pcnve8oyr90szqody5ytdsp243u0hqyaxb8a28i9mi982f3onee2brh64xs5n1oc3iryo6cx1vp6xytuc4tfo98jrx28wq59m3stud2iv00ousv97ocpq9yytv3o2wcncd4ymk2dknr591&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfzdr&__onlt=h)

[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=2j207emmudeckusj8xlgouw9n65dozfz8fd9v6wveoxptmfmnmhy3qv7z8luncy46bgk105vdjfvgutaah6vzysmx7wu7nnl1jfk835ogizs6g41apghku4yg4dl2zs8eml6wv3dt78s5uv5fgyb1y9is9lteb62v4uzysc0h404m9rrugdufppsq38gk02wso0630i2xfur4f0x08zx9k8ryigva27jsmwz3bu6feg165fxuj80ls39uu3coyud1krmsc6r5v3hbkddndadvtb5&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfzdr&__onlt=h)

The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, _the entire parade_ costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ **But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded _entirely_ by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country.** Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever.

* Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.

* Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom.

[**Please join me in support of the National Memorial Day Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, or more right now.**](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=2j207emmudeckusj8xlgouw9n65dozfz907yveune4u14vrk4dd4qer8swko4f8ka3q5egmi8jp8qq3pvpx3onf852t0s76z5mbocpw0i65tvp9o86keixrzcvw704dxn3ox2bsm0pp5s4sokkiunhm0oaf0ajqb9eb0w2cc880g202eyb8x797onll9v2zzkh33u49sbxz7484rct5bazwfyxdqxjqfyi6icv223ultb5hrnb13lr7saq2h2du437jboqs81balrfs9nt2apntg&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfzdr&__onlt=h) If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. _And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get._ You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. _But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade._**** **That's why we are making a concerted effort to ensure these veterans are at this year's National Memorial Day Parade to honor them one last time.** So this year, as we mark the 80th anniversary of victory in Europe and Japan to end World War II – and the 250th anniversaries of the Army, Navy, and Marine Corps – I encourage you to help us honor these brave veterans while we still have them with us.

---
And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day – not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year – please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. _I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more._ _**[Friend, thank you for your support of America's heroes, and please – if you're able, make a gift to fund the National Memorial Day Parade right now during its 20th anniversary.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=2j207emmudeckusj8xlgouw9n65dozfz90gh1gbmlmi3tziy448a8c7yjik7ij41bfk2l848myuege1k0ffciecj3sp29hkid8q3peli3tita7l2tpt7005kyx1qlhb4w66c4uhjsae0dls2hhcmste0ccmppd15k2n91g575jyu8pvv5333rgpjulzu6e46nuxq1yxxbl99ikg0f3xjnc428693mijusod4iqf8fb78vh2f3df7hfuaxpapve01evacfkhxcv5tf7nuns0sgb90&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=svfzdr&__onlt=h)**_ Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honorary Grand Marshal National Memorial Day Parade

I'm grateful to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal on the 20th anniversary of this important event. It's Gary Sinise here... I'm grateful to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal on the 20th anniversary of this important event. | | | Friend, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI: NY – but it was in 1994 playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump that changed my life and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. I've served as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. nearly every year since American Veterans Center revived it in 2005. Now, I'm grateful to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal on the 20th anniversary of this important event. This year will be a remembrance like no other, as we commemorate the 80th anniversary of victory in World War II and the 250th birthdays of the U.S. Army, Navy, and Marine Corps. The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! That means that every dollar that's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event. But I want to reiterate that American Veterans Center does not take ANY federal funding for this event. It is funded entirely by private citizens like you who want to honor those who have sacrificed so much for our country. Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like: Record hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to Today before we lose these stories forever. Hold our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear first-hand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam. Produce veteran focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans the price of our freedom. If you've been looking for an opportunity to give back to those who have given so much for our freedom, this is one of the best possible ways you could do it. And for a special group of veterans, this might be one of the last chances we get. You see, with each year that goes by, we lose more and more of our World War II veterans, and for the few we have remaining, traveling to Washington, D.C., for the parade is difficult. WWII veterans were a key part of the first parade when it was revived in 2005, as they have been every year since for the last 20 years. But this may be the last year we have the opportunity to have these brave men and women with us for the parade. That's why we are making a concerted effort to ensure these veterans are at this year's National Memorial Day Parade to honor them one last time. So this year, as we mark the 80th anniversary of victory in Europe and Japan to end World War II – and the 250th anniversaries of the Army, Navy, and Marine Corps – I encourage you to help us honor these brave veterans while we still have them with us. And no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you. On Memorial Day – not just this momentous year of military milestones, but every year – please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. I believe that while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more. ** Sincerely, Gary Sinise Honorary Grand Marshal National Memorial Day Parade The mission of the American Veterans Center and the World War II Veterans Committee is to preserve and promote the legacy and experiences of America's veterans and active duty service personnel from World War II through today. This is an uncomfortable conversation but it's one we must have.
Democratic Congressman Gerry Connolly has resigned as Ranking Member of the House Oversight Committee. He cites his health and a cancer diagnosis from six months ago as the reason for his resignation.
Here's the thing--I genuinely like Rep. Connolly. He's a man of principle, integrity, and demonstrates a long record of good work, so what I am about to say is not about him as a person, but about the broader broken system harming our democracy that mandates change. The fact is, we should all be furious that Democratic leadership elevated Rep. Connolly to this critical role of Ranking Member knowing full well he was battling incurable cancer, and would very likely be unable to fulfill the enormous public responsibility it demands--especially at a moment when our very democracy is under siege.
This isn't about Connolly's worth as a person. It's about how Democratic leadership keep prioritizing personal loyalty and individual prestige over public service and democratic survival. This pattern of self-inflicted failure is accelerating our collapse, and it must change. **Let 's Address This.**
**I am doing everything in my power to raise awareness on human rights and justice. I cannot do it alone. I hope you consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.**
