## Public Service Means PUBLIC, Not Personal
Public service is exactly that -- PUBLIC. SERVICE. It is not meant to be a reward for personal loyalty, longevity, or legacy. It is meant to ensure the best possible leadership for the most public good. And yet, Democrats once again elevated a dying public servant to fight a fascist movement that is vicious, coordinated, and entirely unencumbered by sentimentality.
Democratic Party leadership could have elevated Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez--a sharp, strategic, relentless advocate for democracy and human rights. She wanted the role. She fought for the role. She was ready. But instead, we chose symbolism over service. Now, after losing 100 crucial days of momentum, we have to hit the reset button yet again--all while MAGA Republicans plot to gut Medicaid, hand $4.8 trillion in tax cuts to 800 billionaires, arrests judges, and deport anyone who dares dissent.
And this is not an isolated event. It is a _pattern_ that is crippling the Democratic Party and hurting the country. Already _this_ term, two Democratic members of Congress, both in their 70s, both with serious health concerns (one with cancer), died in office. Now, Donald Trump has an even larger majority in the House, requiring more Republicans to defect to protect critical needs like Medicaid, Social Security, and SNAP and TANF. And far from isolated incidents, this is a destructive pattern we see not just in the House, but also in the Senate and in the Supreme Court.
## Senator Dianne Feinstein: A Tragic Warning Ignored
When Senator Dianne Feinstein began visibly struggling with severe cognitive decline, the world watched in horror as Democratic leadership refused to act. Colleagues and staffers whispered about her inability to conduct basic duties, yet publicly enabled her to cling to power.
Instead of retiring with dignity and allowing a new generation to rise up, Democratic Party leadership prioritized preserving seniority and committee control--while Republicans gleefully blocked judges, overturned rights, and dismantled civil protections. It was a moral and strategic failure. Senator Feinstein handed over power of attorney to a family member because she could not be trusted to make decisions about her own healthcare, while simultaneously refusing to cede power over decisions that impact the rights of 330 million Americans. Does that make sense to anyone? Her refusal to resign or retire is a reminder that public service must never devolve into personal entitlement. But once again, Democrats chose personal over public--and the nation paid the price.
## Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg: A Painful But Necessary Reflection
Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg was a towering figure in American law and civil rights. Her contributions are historic and profound. As a young law student, her example and courage inspired me--particularly her advocacy for women's rights.
But here's the hard truth. Her refusal to retire during President Obama's administration--despite repeated urgings from even close allies--led directly to Donald Trump installing her replacement. Instead, [she retorted to critics in 2014](https://substack.com/redirect/7ed865f8-c026-44f1-a931-00ac88e64607?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "_So tell me who the president could have nominated this spring that you would rather see on the court than me_?" She missed the point that it was never about her, but about the public. And the assertion that no other Judge existed who was qualified to sit on the Supreme Court to carry on a legacy of civil rights? Well, that line of thinking is what enabled our current predicament--where the Heritage Foundation's hand picked her replacement in right wing firebrand Amy Coney Barrett.
It's uncomfortable to acknowledge. It feels disrespectful. But if we are serious about saving democracy, we must tell the full truth. Ginsberg's decision, fueled at least in part by personal ambition and a belief in her own irreplaceability, opened the door for a radical, ultra-right Supreme Court majority. The right has already used that court to overturn Roe v. Wade, gut voting rights, erode environmental protections, gift Trump near unlimited immunity, and more. And they are just getting started.
Love and respect for RBG's legacy demands honesty about her mistakes--so that we do not repeat them.
## President Joe Biden: The Bridge That Never Arrived
When Joe Biden ran for president in 2020, he famously declared he was a "[bridge to a new generation of leadership](https://substack.com/redirect/bd2898c6-0154-4404-9bf9-f3c6635a4355?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." That promise inspired millions--not because we doubted Biden's character--but because we recognized that a thriving democracy requires passing the torch. I've already written about the immense benefit to the Democratic Party and more importantly to our country when we have robust primaries, [and the immense harm when we don't](https://substack.com/redirect/ea306606-b2af-46a9-8019-1f162554cf75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Instead, as evidence mounted that he was struggling with age-related decline--[and as his own aides privately admitted they saw these warning signs](https://substack.com/redirect/b64180d7-f504-4851-9ef8-d2e13a318010?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--Biden refused to step aside. His stubbornness endangered not just his own legacy, but the very democracy he pledged to defend.
Once again, personal ego was prioritized over public service. Once again, Democrats repeated the same fatal mistakes. And the consequences in November were predictably catastrophic. ([I've written at length on the unfair task handed to VP Harris to run an entire Presidential campaign in just 90 days](https://substack.com/redirect/bc373f97-7ade-4119-b975-517a3fb8f58b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
## The Bottom Line: Deterioration Disguised as Loyalty
Let's be clear: This is not about ageism. It is not about ableism. It is about _fitness_ for duty--and the absolute moral obligation to prioritize the public good over personal ego. It is not ageism or ableism that our laws require air traffic controllers to retire at 56. It is a recognition that cognitive abilities rapidly decline at a certain age, and we cannot risk the lives and well beings of travelers with an air traffic controller who is suffering age related cognitive decline.
So, when Democratic leadership repeatedly promotes those who can no longer fully serve, it doesn't just weaken institutions--it enables fascism. It leaves critical positions vacant or ineffective when we need them most. It gives extremists a free hand to seize power. It kills democracy by a thousand self-inflicted cuts. For example, the two Democratic members of Congress who died while in office this term, will not be replaced until as late as this November in special elections. That gives Republicans nearly 9 months of an unfair advantage to pass their fascist agendas without a duly elected Democrat in those districts. Does this sound fair, let alone smart, to anyone?
This pattern isn't just bad politics. It's a horrifying enabler of fascism. Reserving leadership for a small, increasingly disconnected elite class while leaving the public defenseless against injustice, violence, and authoritarianism is simply inexcusable.
Fascism thrives when good people cling to power long past their time--when self-importance replaces public duty. When the politics of politeness replaces the principle of public service. Red or blue, left or right--we must oppose this broken model and demand better. We must remember that true public service means knowing when to lead--and when to step aside so others can lead.
## Conclusion
Rep. Gerry Connolly served a long and fulfilling career. I commend him for his service. It is not an attack on him to state the fact that he should not have run for a leadership role, and the Democratic Party should not have elevated his role, when he knew full well that he was dying of an incurable cancer. The next test is to determine who will replace Rep. Connolly--both as Ranking Member of the powerful House Oversight Committee, and as the next Congressperson for his current district. My hope is that the Democratic Party leans into its base by having a robust primary without tipping the scales, and elects a dynamic young leader to lead the party and develop new talent--not repeat the same playbook that got us here in the first place.
Otherwise, we've seen where this broken model leads, and that is not a price any of us should be willing to pay or tolerate.

body:
A little fact about California and Texas that you should keep handy.

California just passed Japan as the fourth largest economy in the world. This is a real point of pride for us. We're a big big blue state that produces 14% of the Gross Domestic Product of the United States and 50% more than the next big state.
But here's something you won't ever hear on Fox News:
We're a donor state. In 2023, Californians contributed $83.1 billion more than we received from the federal government.
And Texas? They TOOK $71.1 billion more than they provided the federal government.
**[Watch this clip.](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/4156?t=1&akid=2330%2E4767699%2E-o5brW)**
[](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/4156?t=2&akid=2330%2E4767699%2E-o5brW)
I say that to make a broader point. Seventy-one percent of the economic output in the United States comes from blue counties, blue metros, blue states—places with lower rates of deaths of despair, higher wages, greater productivity, stronger growth, and lower death rates as it relates to murder.
It is a mythology that somehow red states are dominating and blue states are struggling. It's factually untrue.
Gavin Newsom

Hi Peter, it’s Grace here – finance director for George Whitesides’ re-election campaign in CA-27.

I know you’re probably hearing a lot from candidates across the country about the importance of their race. Let me explain why ours is unique:
* **George was one of only a few Democrats to flip a Republican-held seat back in November.** It made him an instant GOP target and he’s already facing attacks.
*
* **The midterm elections are our only chance to flip the House majority while Trump is in office.** We need accountability, and while George is fighting hard in Congress, oversight will come with a win in 2026.

Look, Peter:

If there’s one thing Governor Andy Beshear knows, it’s that leadership is about showing up, listening, sticking to your values, and fighting for the people you serve — _no matter how tough the road gets_.

Andy’s doing just that. This month alone, Andy’s been having conversations with folks from all over Kentucky and the country — _governors, community leaders, business owners, teachers and more_ — about what it means to lead with commonsense values and put people first.

And here’s what we’re hearing: Americans are ready for leaders who will protect their freedoms, bring good-paying jobs to their communities, and stand up to extremist agendas trying to take us backward. But let’s be clear: **These critical races aren’t going to win themselves. The road ahead is tough, and we can expect deep-pocketed special interests to get involved—just like we saw in Wisconsin, where Elon Musk spent over $20 million to try to buy a State Supreme Court seat.**

We’re building on the lessons from Andy’s race here in Kentucky — where grassroots grit and people-powered organizing made the difference — and applying them nationwide. But to keep up the momentum and help elect more commonsense leaders, we need to hit our crucial end-of-month fundraising goal.

body:
That’s not a typo – I’m really only asking for one buck.

[](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI1MDQyOF9RSS1FRi4xMTQ1MTBfdDE2MzI4MTQtMzYyMyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNTA0MjhfUUktRUYuMTE0NTEwX3QxNjMyODE0LTM2MjMifQ/A1Zbvut78lGKdwMUNnamYg)Bernie Sanders thinks you're too weak to work hard and get ahead.
That's not an exaggeration - that's his worldview.

name: Judicial Watch Tipsheet
subject: Judicial Watch: New York Authorities Planned to Euthanize ‘Peanut the Squirrel’ and ‘Fred the Raccoon’ Before Seizing Them from Owner
body:
Judicial Watch announced it received 163 pages of records from the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation in a Freedom of Information Law (FOIL) lawsuit which show authorities had planned to euthanize a squirrel named “Peanut” and a raccoon named “Fred” before they were seized from Pine City, NY, resident Mark Longo.

We've got a House and Senate to win back in 2026, and the road will be rough. But here's what else we both know: We've got friends in the fight. EMILYs List has been changing the face of power in American politics for 40 years now. Their mission to elect more women by investing early in their campaigns, when dollars go the furthest, has been revolutionary. I'm an EMILYs List endorsee myself — I know firsthand how vital the support of this community can be! = | = As the new chair of the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, I will spend the next two years laser-focused on helping Democrats win back the Senate, and I know EMILYs List will be right there with me in the fight. We only need to flip four seats to take back the chamber, and looking at the Senate map, we'll have several good chances to flip Republican-held seats. This is about stopping extremism, Peter. | | The Left just can’t get it right—they overreacted to COVID, closing schools and mandating masks, firing people who wouldn’t take an experimental vaccine, and under-reacting to the epidemic of chronic disease.

By Illinois Review

JB Pritzker – a progressive liberal who inherited billions from his family’s hotel business – delivered a shocking speech in The Granite State, where he called for violence against the Trump agenda, saying “It’s time to fight, everywhere, all at once.”

In addition to the migrant crisis, Chicago’s crime rates remain high, and in 2023, the city maintained its status as America’s “murder capital.”

The Democratic presidential hopeful’s speech was laced with violent rhetoric throughout the evening as he called for “mass protests” and “disruption” – even telling the crowd that,

“Republicans cannot know a moment of peace.”

body:
I sued to stop Trump and the U.S. Department of Education from withholding $7.9 billion from California’s schools.
# [](https://act.robbonta.com/go/3?refcode=em20250426&t=1&akid=1757%2E1088799%2EJ7gSc-)
President Trump’s Department of Education is threatening to withhold federal funding from states that refuse to end diversity, equity, and inclusion programs designed to promote equal access to education in our nation’s schools.
**So last week, I filed my 15th lawsuit against this administration to fight back.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250426?refcode=em20250428-1757&refcode2=1757_1088799_J7gSc-&akid=1757%2E1088799%2EJ7gSc-)
The Trump administration is holding **$7.9 BILLION** hostage from California children and schools unless state and local agencies terminate lawful efforts to ensure equal access to education for all of our students.
This is yet another illegal power grab by Trump to cut funding that was already approved by Congress. With this order, Trump and Secretary Linda McMahon are abandoning our kids.
**If Trump gets his way, our state could lose billions in funding that pays for:**
* Financial support to ensure that students from low-income families have the same access to high-quality education as their peers;
* Special education services for students with disabilities;
* Recruitment and training of highly skilled and dedicated teachers;
* Programming for non-native speakers to learn English;
* Support for vulnerable children in foster care and without housing.

This is an attack on our children and yet another attempt by Trump and his administration to break the law.
**[That’s why I took urgent action and filed a lawsuit last Friday to stop this. name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-12927717?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| Friends and Neighbors,

This past week in Tallahassee was filled with meaningful action and impactful progress for our district and state. My fellow House members and I are working hard to ensure Floridians come first and that our state remains the Free State of Florida for generations to come.

This legislative session has had its challenges, but it has been a pleasure to serve alongside my fellow freshman class members over the last few months. We still have some work to do before we conclude our time in Tallahassee, but I look forward to furthering our efforts and keeping you updated on our accomplishments. Stay tuned!

As always, my office is here to serve you. Please do not hesitate to [**contact my team**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=d402dad643&e=d1c1b9864f) if you need assistance with anything. We would be happy to help in any way we can!
---
| | **Bills Presented on the House Floor: HB 113**
---
|
---
| My bill, [CS/CS/HB 113 - Fleeing or Attempting to Elude a Law Enforcement Officer](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=60ed0817d8&e=d1c1b9864f), passed on the House Floor. This bill increases penalties for those who flee from law enforcement while also strengthening accountability through enhancement on the police scorecard. This legislation makes it clear that if you flee from or elude law enforcement, you will face serious consequences. I would like to thank **MCSO Lt. Paul Bloom** and **Sheriff Billy Woods** for bringing this bill to me last year. I’m truly thankful that we were able to get this passed on the House Floor this year!

Watch me speak on this bill on the House Floor by clicking [here](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=b9a9d45edf&e=d1c1b9864f) and [here](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=c9da09bc19&e=d1c1b9864f)!
---
| | **Bills Presented on the House Floor: HB 4067**
---
| Another one of my bills, [CS/HB 4067 (Local Bill) - Equestrian Sport Facilities in Marion County](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=180cc81059&e=d1c1b9864f), passed on the House Floor. This bill protects what makes our area special by helping ease regulatory challenges as the **World Equestrian Center** continues its impressive growth. Thanks to the heavy support of our local equestrian community, we were able to get this bill through the legislative process.
---
| | **Floor Shout-Out!**
---
|
---
| Students from **Marion County’s Forest High School’s College and Career Advanced Placement Academy** came up to Tallahassee, and I had the privilege of meeting with them and recognizing them on the House Floor. These students take a minimum of 10 AP classes over four years and earn their CTE certification while doing so.

Watch this recognition on the House Floor by clicking [here](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=8c212dadd5&e=d1c1b9864f)!
---
| | **Ringing of the Bell Ceremony**
---
|
---
| On Tuesday, I had the distinct honor of attending the **Ringing of the Bell Ceremony** to honor the 13 fallen firefighters who died in the line of duty this past year. It was a solemn reminder of the bravery, sacrifice, and courage that these heroes display every day. Their memories will be forever inscribed outside the Capitol.
---
| | **Receptions & Events in Tallahassee**
---
| My staff and I attended various receptions and events in Tallahassee last week, including:
* **Conservation FL, FL Wildlife Corridor**
* **Southern Rock Reception Clay County**
* **Senator Bob Graham Honoring Reception**
* ******Caribbean-American Heritage Day Celebration**

---
| | **Florida House: Week in Review**
---
| We had a productive week in Tallahassee last week, and I want to ensure the district stays informed and knows that the Florida House is working hard for you. Please click [here](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=79bc4f2e7d&e=d1c1b9864f) to read the **Florida House’s Week in Review** newsletter to learn more about what we accomplished for our state and communities.
---
|
---
| | Thank you for reading, and I look forward to sharing with you again soon.

Have a great week!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

name: John Fetterman
subject: in honor of Workers Memorial Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
[ https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/50678?t=1001&akid=10064%2E434096%2EJLfve3 ]John Fetterman

Hey Derek, it’s John.

Today is Workers Memorial Day. It’s a day to remember the workers who were injured, disabled, or lost their lives just doing their jobs.

Today, we honor the folks who clocked in and never made it home. And the best way to do that is by taking action.

Every time we talk about a worker who died on the job, we *need* to talk about corporate greed – and how it can lead to unsafe conditions, faulty equipment, exhausting hours, and little to no protections for the folks who actually do the work.

So what's the main thing that can keep workers safe? One word: Unions.

They help workers collectively bargain for fair contracts, fair wages, and safe working conditions.

That’s why I always say: The Union Way of Life is sacred. And I’ll never stop fighting to protect it.

But Trump and his billionaire friends are attacking the Union Way of Life right now. From stripping nearly a million federal workers of their union membership to looking to their Project 2025 playbook that includes:

🚨 Letting corporations secretly union-bust behind closed doors
❌ Allowing employers to ditch union contracts midway through
🛑 Letting states ban unions altogether
🤬 Gutting overtime + wage protections

...they want to break unions and make CEOs richer.

They want to divide and conquer, but they don't know who they're messing with. So while Trump tries to push his union-busting Project 2025 agenda, I'll keep fighting for a future where your skills are valued the way they should be.

I want every nurse, steelworker, teacher, cement mason, contractor – every single working person, whether you're in a union or you're still fighting for one – to know: I got your back. Always will.

Because I know this isn’t just about jobs. It’s about justice, and safety. It’s about the survival of working families. So as we remember the workers we’ve lost, we honor them by fighting every damn day.

Derek, if you're in this with me, and you want to help protect the Union Way of Life, would you pitch in a few bucks ahead of my end-of-month fundraising deadline so we can keep fighting for working folks in PA + across the country?

https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51032?t=1002&akid=10064%2E434096%2EJLfve3

In solidarity,

John ❤️

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.johnfetterman.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=1003&akid=10064%2E434096%2EJLfve3

clean_body: It's all been lie after lie after lie. | | | Peter, Working families around the country are already feeling the effects of the cuts and disastrous policies enacted by Trump and Musk. And it’s about to get worse. They claim to care about “efficiency” in government. That, somehow, indiscriminately slashing federal funding, laying off thousands of workers, and gutting Social Security would help working people. It’s been lie after lie after lie. The truth is, all they care about is their own power, and cutting massive checks for billionaires and lobbyists — including giving a record-setting $1 trillion to the Pentagon. 1 Or a $6 billion contract to Musk’s own company, SpaceX.2 Or tipping off donors to insider trading opportunities around their disastrous tariffs.3 Or running a nearly $1 billion-dollar crypto scam directly from the White House.4 Make no mistake: Trump and Musk never cared about “efficiency.” They never cared about helping working people with anything. It has ALWAYS been about stealing from the rest of us to enrich the wealthiest few. That’s why we need more working class champions in office, all over the country, who will actually stand up to them — and fight for us. Together, we can and WILL elect more leaders who will fight for us instead of the wealthy donor class. Every new leader we recruit, support, and elect means more people in positions of power who know what it’s like to worry about putting food on the table, paying rent, or covering medical bills. In solidarity, Team WFP P.S. subject: BREAKING: The DNC launches a new organizing program, join Democrats for an Organizing Briefing on April 30 at 8 p.m.
body:
---
Derek — In just a few short months, Trump has launched attacks on our freedoms, empowered extremists, and made clear that his second term will be even more dangerous than the first. We can’t afford to sit back and wait — **we need to organize, and we need to organize now.** That’s why the DNC is launching our new organizing program, a bold new initiative to harness grassroots energy, call out Republican extremism, and build lasting power in communities across the country. Alongside this launch, we’re hosting an Organizing Briefing on April 30 at 8 p.m., centered around the destructive first 100 days of the Trump administration, and we’d love for you to join. During the call, hear from DNC leadership about:
1. How the DNC is holding Trump and the GOP accountable
2. The Organizing Principles guiding our work
3. How YOU can be an effective organizer and hold Republicans accountable yourself

[You can use this link to RSVP and receive more details:](http://ak.democrats.org/event/organizing-briefings/483924/signup/?refcode=em_20250428_3298_do&akid=3298%2E22930333%2EkmSSXr) **[RSVP TODAY](http://ak.democrats.org/event/organizing-briefings/483924/signup/?refcode=em_20250428_3298_do&akid=3298%2E22930333%2EkmSSXr)** Whether you’re a longtime volunteer or new to organizing, this event is your starting point to plug in, get trained, and take action. Thank you for your continued support, The Democrats

_If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support._

| Peter,

President Donald Trump is using his executive power to launch an investigation into ActBlue, the fundraising platform that our campaign and nearly every other Democratic campaign across the country use to collect donations.

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106688500/542318777/-1812448514?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYzQyODEzZC03NDI0LWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Gt-lOsCzlnrwcYTMTF6pNGD6FRPLdMR64HG9oqQxc4o=)
Peter, Before running for Congress, I remember my inbox getting flooded with desperate, hair-on-fire emails from other Democratic campaigns. **To be honest, I hated them.** The deadlines always seemed arbitrary, and they were often full of obnoxious scare tactics. In my opinion, Democratic donors have _plenty_ of real reasons why they should support our cause. Exaggerating the stakes is counterproductive. That's why I told my team from the start that we would do things differently. Yes, the stakes are high. And yes, this probably leaves a few dollars on the table compared to the nonstop barrages from some organizations you know. But we won't feed into the same panic that's caused distrust and dysfunction over the years. So today I want to give it to you straight. We have two days until our next deadline of my reelection campaign at midnight on April 30th. Showing strength right now is critical, and the good news is my team tells me we're getting close! # Stephen Miller takes WRECKING BALL to woke reporters challenging TDA deportations
Trump Deputy Chief of Staff Stephen Miller once again **[took on an army of mainstream media reporters](https://substack.com/redirect/3719ba57-5bbb-42ee-873d-4e32c32f39e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** outside the White House, singlehandedly defending the administration's deportation of Tren de Aragua gang members.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/3719ba57-5bbb-42ee-873d-4e32c32f39e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3719ba57-5bbb-42ee-873d-4e32c32f39e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
One of the many reporters demanded evidence from the administration that all individuals deported on certain flights were members of Tren de Aragua.
Miller assured her that "they are all Tren de Aragua." He expressed the severity of the situation facing the Trump administration, justifying their swift action to deport security threats like gang members. "Let's say you have a family living in a neighborhood with little children and next to them is a TDA gang member who was sent here by a hostile regime,..."
"Do our counter terrorism officers **[arrest and remove the terrorists?"](https://substack.com/redirect/3719ba57-5bbb-42ee-873d-4e32c32f39e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Miller asked the reporters rhetorically. "Or do we say 'we'll leave you there, you can rape and murder the people next to you, and only after you rape and murder then we'll remove you?!'"
"We're not gonna let anyone get raped or murdered by terrorists!" he added.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/3719ba57-5bbb-42ee-873d-4e32c32f39e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

**By Rudy Giuliani**
With the passing of Pope Francis--may he rest in peace--the faithful face a pivotal moment. For millions of Catholics worldwide, the papacy is not just a symbol; it's the spiritual anchor, the guiding light in a world drowning in moral confusion. Today, as secularism, wokeism, and modernism erode the foundations of faith, we need a pope who will fiercely defend the Church's timeless traditions, not bend to the fleeting whims of a culture gone astray. We need a leader like **[Cardinal Robert Sarah](https://substack.com/redirect/298cd975-dd75-40f3-8d71-2ad48b89f3d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** --a bold, anti-woke, pro-life traditionalist--to steer the Church back to its unwavering moral core.
Let's be clear: the Church is not a political institution, nor should it chase popularity contests. Its mission is eternal--to proclaim the truth of Christ, to uphold the sanctity of life, marriage, and family, and to provide a moral compass for a world desperate for meaning. But under Pope Francis, God bless him, we saw a papacy that too often flirted with modern ideologies, softening the Church's stance to appease left-wing interests. His efforts to embrace inclusivity and environmental causes, while well-intentioned, diluted the Church's moral clarity. The faithful don't need a pope who panders to the progressive elite. They need a shepherd who stands firm, unapologetically proclaiming the Gospel in a world that's lost its way...

Last week I filmed a video about a new idea the Trump Administration is floating... teaching women about their menstrual cycles in an attempt to increase the number of babies born in the U.S. _[You can watch here.](https://substack.com/redirect/52a1640c-a404-4005-a5a3-d5cfc1e6c75e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) _This Substack, _Beyond the Whiteboard,_ lets me say more than I can fit in a minute on social media, so I hope you'll keep reading.
**This Trump initiative is about government pushing for a certain type of family:**
Elon Musk talks about his "legion" of kids taking over the world. It's creepy and feels like bad scifi, but he's not the only person thinking this way. Many in the so-called natalist movement are worried about white people being outnumbered, and so let's call this what it is--**white nationalism**. This is blatantly racist and bad, but for the sake of facts, I also want to point out that birth rates are [declining](https://substack.com/redirect/2a4f91d1-2442-4635-8271-b2b66a60f6ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across the globe. Beyond race--these natalists also want a certain type of family; married, straight, parents with a mom who stays at home and raises the kids. For those of us who don't fit that mold, there's an implicit condemnation of our parenting as somehow un-American.
**If you want more children ...lower the cost of having them!**
Poll after poll shows that the reason some people are having fewer children, delaying having kids, or not having them altogether is because everything involved with raising them is too expensive. **Our country has not invested in the things families with kids need:** affordable child care, housing, health care and college. And those big expenses are on top of the rising cost of day-to-day things like diapers and groceries. When I posted my video, my thoughtful followers chimed in with all sorts of other roadblocks: like a lack of nationwide paid family leave and enormous hospital bills for giving birth.
**Reproductive freedom is under attack:**
Every person should be able to choose for themselves if and when to have kids. But JD Vance seems to think he knows best. From making it harder to get birth control to abortion bans, this isn't about hypothetical actions--politicians already are eroding our rights to reproductive choice. **Republicans have said they want to ban abortion nationwide, and less than 100 days into Trump 2.0 we are seeing they mean every word they 've said. **We must stay loud and vigilant to at LEAST keep abortion safe, legal, and accessible in states like California.
I'm a mom of three who loves my kids, and I want families who want kids to be able to thrive--that's the American dream. **The high cost of everything should not stand in the way of having kids, and if we make the right investments in healthcare, housing, child care, and education, it doesn't have to.**
It's maddening to me that Republicans want to spend taxpayer dollars telling Americans how to get pregnant and pushing their values, instead of investing in things that help parents and kids succeed.
Katie Porter

name: Donavan McKinney
subject: Working-class Detroiters deserve better. So let’s give them better.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Let me introduce myself, Peter:
I’m Donavan McKinney, and I’m running for Congress in Michigan’s 13th
district to give working-class Detroiters the representation they deserve.

I can’t tell you how excited I am to be Justice Democrats’ first
endorsement of the 2026 election cycle. With you on my team, I’m ready to
challenge Detroit’s out-of-touch, self-funded, multimillionaire incumbent
who cozies up to corporate donors — and I’m ready to empower my community
with leadership that actually fights for them, no matter the political
cost.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250428-2-dm?refcode=em20250428-36612&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36612_1203867_lDG2G9&akid=36612%2E1203867%2ElDG2G9 ]But before I share more of my story with you, I have to ask: will you
become a founding donor of my grassroots campaign today, and help me show
the country we can beat a millionaire without taking a single cent of
corporate PAC money ourselves?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250428-2-dm?refcode=em20250428-36612&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36612_1203867_lDG2G9&akid=36612%2E1203867%2ElDG2G9 ]Image of Donavan McKinney, smiling and with his arms crossed. He is
wearing a blue zippered-up sweatshirt over a white shirt. Blurred in the
background is a basketball court in front of a green field backed by green
houses and trees. The sky is blue.

Born in Detroit and raised by my mother and grandmother, I learned the
importance of community, leadership, and service early on in life. I’m a
proud product of Detroit Public Schools, and proud to be the first in the
family that raised me to become a college graduate.

After receiving my degree from the University of Michigan-Ann Arbor, I put
my education into action. I served as a Legislative Director in the
Michigan State House of Representatives and undertook community engagement
work for a local nonprofit called Community Development Advocates of
Detroit (CDAD). I also worked in admissions and helped improve student
life at Wayne County Community College District (WCCCD), and spent time
fighting for workers at the largest healthcare union in the state, SEIU
Healthcare Michigan. I care deeply about our students, our unions, and our
working families, who are just trying to get by and create fulfilling
lives they can be proud of.

I also care deeply about climate change and environmental justice. Growing
up in the shadow of Detroit’s smokestacks and factories, I developed a
cough I still have today — a cough my mother and grandmother have too, and
a cough I’m committed to preventing in my two young children. Before I
became a State Rep. – fighting to make our air and water cleaner, among
many other things — I was the National Political Director for Climate
Power, an environmental organization dedicated to helping communities,
leaders, and elected officials alike understand the benefits of investing
in clean energy. And in 2020, I was appointed by Governor Gretchen Whitmer
to serve on Michigan’s first Environmental Justice Council, where I have
advocated for water accessibility and affordability. And as a Detroiter, a
State Rep., and a parent, I’m proud to have helped fund over $600 million
to replace lead pipes in Detroit and its suburbs, because no parent should
have to worry about their children’s drinking water poisoning them.

Since 2023, I’ve had the honor of serving the people of Southeast Michigan
in the Michigan State House. For the last two years as a state
representative, I’ve prioritized increasing access to health care,
ensuring every child in Michigan receives a quality education, improving
the criminal justice system, and securing the rights of unions and
workers.

My life’s work has been about improving the lives of everyday people in
Michigan. It’s about time we had someone in this seat truly committed to
doing the same. As long as there are multimillionaires like Rep. Shri
Thanedar in Congress — who think you can buy a seat, not earn it — the
needs of working-class people in districts like Michigan’s 13th will go
ignored and unmet.

Well, I’m not running because I’m a millionaire. I’m running because I’m
not.

I’m running because this fight — the 99% vs the 1% — is so much bigger
than one person or one office. It’s about our kids, our futures, and our
community — and the fact that we all deserve representation that truly
fights for every one of us.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250428-2-dm?refcode=em20250428-36612&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36612_1203867_lDG2G9&akid=36612%2E1203867%2ElDG2G9 ]We are in this Democratic primary to win it, and to bring our fight for
working-class Detroiters to Congress — but we can’t do it without you.
Help set our campaign up for success from the jump with a grassroots
contribution of anything you can give today.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250428-2-dm?refcode=em20250428-36612&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36612_1203867_lDG2G9&akid=36612%2E1203867%2ElDG2G9 ]Contribute $5

We’ve got a long road ahead of us, but I know that, together, we’ll get
there — so let’s get to work!

Thank you,

Donavan

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20250428-36612-footer&t=1002&refcode2=36612_1203867_lDG2G9&akid=36612%2E1203867%2ElDG2G9

| | | | | Hi,
I'm not a career politician. I'm an Air Force Veteran born in Toledo, OH, who has spent my career defending America: the country that gave me a second chance.

The failed candidate in last November’s state supreme court race has sued to try to throw out enough legally valid ballots to overturn his loss. And a new ruling greenlights his request to disenfranchise military personnel and overseas citizens.
**Let's be clear: This decision abandons the judiciary’s most basic role, to protect the rights of the people, and sanctions an outright attempt to steal an election.**
This alarming development is a stark, present-day example of what we've seen throughout our nation’s history: far-right leaders going to extraordinary lengths to bypass democratic principles — _all in their relentless pursuit of power._
Whether it's through onerous voting requirements, partisan gerrymanders, or attempting to use courts to invalidate legitimate election results, the goal is the same — to undermine the fundamental right of Americans to have their voices heard.

clean_body: | Peter, On Friday, I was honored to speak at our People’s Town Hall in Spokane. The energy was electric – we had over 200 people show up to listen and share stories about how the Trump-Musk agenda is affecting their lives. = We held the town hall in Washington’s 5th District, which voted for Trump by a wide margin. But this event wasn’t about party or politics. It was about people. Naida Spencer, a U.S. Navy veteran, spoke about cuts to the VA and DOGE firing thousands of veterans from federal jobs. Jenny Slagle, a Spokane School Board Member, described what the elimination of the Department of Education would mean for kids in local schools. Everyone in the room was angry about the destructive Trump agenda – and they aren’t going to sit by while a handful of billionaires and politicians dismantle everything we hold dear. Together, we need to harness this energy to keep pressure on Congressional Republicans, whether they are in swing districts like Arizona’s 6th or deep-red areas like Washington’s 5th! = These town halls are having an impact. body:
I started The Long Run with one goal in mind: To help elect promising candidates from diverse, working class backgrounds
#
Friend —
I started The Long Run with one goal in mind: To help elect promising candidates from diverse, working class backgrounds. The kind of candidates who don’t usually get political and financial support when they decide to run for office and make a difference in their communities.
And listen, I’ve run my fair share of campaigns. I know how these things work. Once you announce that you want to run, the first question everyone asks is **“can you raise enough money to win?”**
It’s sad that money is so important in our political system, but it’s the game we have to play. And so many candidates who don’t fit the status quo — candidates who are Black, Brown, working class, LGBTQ+, disabled — struggle to get their campaigns off the ground simply because they don’t have the resources they need to be successful.
**_Or in other words, they don’t have a bunch of rich friends they can call up and ask for donations.**_
So, it’s April 2025. I know for many people the next election seems like this far-off thing in the future.
But if we want to see more working class leaders in Congress and more progressive fighters who will stand up to Donald Trump and Elon Musk, **we have to start investing right now, when it matters most.**
That’s why I’m asking you today: [**Will you make a contribution of $5 or whatever you can afford to The Long Run today? Help power our work as we start investing in the candidates who can take on the far-right and WIN in 2026.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-april25.epcG-f&refcode=em250216-1-240&t=1&akid=5534%2E196590%2Evf25_H)

Peter Thiel is the co-founder of Paypal and Palantir, and his latest claim to fame is underwriting anti-choice extremist JD Vance. Thiel played a major role in Vance's rise to national political prominence, spending $15 million on his 2022 Senate race, and ultimately helped pave the way for his selection as Donald Trump's running mate.

Thiel has led the push for Silicon Valley's richest to shift to the right politically, towards the most extreme Republicans. And after taking 2024 off, Thiel is back. In the first three months of 2025 he's already donated over $1.3 million to Republican committees working to hold the GOP House and Senate majorities.

This upcoming cycle, Thiel could target key races where Democratic pro-choice women like **Janelle Bynum (OR-05)** and **Rep. Laura Gillen (NY-04)** won by razor-thin margins in 2024. In fact, he's already maxed out the legal donation amount to the vulnerable Republican running against **Rebecca Cooke (WI-03)**. In 2022, he spent millions trying to turn Arizona red, and this year we've endorsed **Marlene Galán-Woods (AZ-01)** to oust a vulnerable GOP incumbent in the House.

clean_body: He's already maxed out the legal donation amount to the Republican running against Rebecca Cooke in WI-03. | = Peter — Thanks in part to supporters like you making him toxic to Republican candidates, Elon Musk recently announced that he's "taking a step back" from politics. But unfortunately, he's far from the last extremist billionaire bankrolling Republicans — including those trying to defeat EMILYs List candidates. In fact, I'm sorry to have to report that tech billionaire and longtime GOP megadonor Peter Thiel , who didn't spend directly on candidates in 2024, is now returning to rightwing politics — and that could make things a lot harder for Democrats this cycle. = | = Peter Thiel is the co-founder of Paypal and Palantir, and his latest claim to fame is underwriting anti-choice extremist JD Vance. Thiel played a major role in Vance's rise to national political prominence, spending $15 million on his 2022 Senate race, and ultimately helped pave the way for his selection as Donald Trump's running mate. Thiel has led the push for Silicon Valley's richest to shift to the right politically, towards the most extreme Republicans. And after taking 2024 off, Thiel is back. In the first three months of 2025 he's already donated over $1.3 million to Republican committees working to hold the GOP House and Senate majorities. This upcoming cycle, Thiel could target key races where Democratic pro-choice women like Janelle Bynum (OR-05) and Rep. Laura Gillen (NY-04) won by razor-thin margins in 2024. In fact, he's already maxed out the legal donation amount to the vulnerable Republican running against Rebecca Cooke (WI-03). In 2022, he spent millions trying to turn Arizona red, and this year we've endorsed Marlene Galán-Woods (AZ-01) to oust a vulnerable GOP incumbent in the House. As we close in on the first 100 days of Donald Trump’s second administration, his approval ratings are plummeting as Americans see no end to his chaos.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106692415/542331869/-1080040549?refcode=email-header&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNTZkNmUzMC04MDI0LWYwMTEtOGIzZC02MDQ1YmRlZDhjY2EiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T7uxUiAkMiheTLH4y3TFHK9Fsm2T8enAMQ8HAzzXNkw=) Team, as we close in on the first 100 days of Donald Trump’s second administration, Trump’s approval ratings are plummeting as Americans see no end to his chaos. So I’m asking: = The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Many give less. Some give more. All that matters is that lots and lots of people are contributing what they can to power our grassroots campaign. Please, contribute today. | = Thanks for being part of this team. As always, Jon Ossoff * = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I am truly honored to have won reelection, and I promise to continue the critical work toward bipartisan solutions for New Yorkers as we enter this new term. While we had many victories in New York this election season, our fight to retake control of the Senate is far from over. = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

My fellow Americans - it is Vice President JD Vance.

_**[This is a longer email but I respectfully ask you to read it from start to finish.](https://links.iterable.com/s/c/Umnf6M35agzkPTP6LLt7g-NYm1MfYH_SfrgwINSXQAxmvE-KLu-QHBWYlZmM4bXyRkhzbkYo2ujO4ZG7k8sw7g5vF2ey-BtfU4Br9uRtcVRVm57hiJjMHBZmrmBEf44c4HHa8p9R11FMNvOEsGy0OyrnsxFkTSJgRkHXwZZzYOSl9H85EjpEGpXFalSQCxN2nDZRL91_OfJ3VL8Mj2bl48Tet6O2T7ES9cZaOPwznWg8thoCFGc_As5HIXX92vZaVBQSeSnm2_yrGiwChhoHVkrwOIDSMpt5_1pr69G5ZAl4vChYlXlt4U5Ljx0Lh1Qvyod2tl9crab8b4HasdIUV9TVsQn6Di7_FPw7iKknlWU7G_eYrA0WFb42EXpnxDTNcFp7PkcesemVsnMyJlYfR20pQMc1S8h2mih9y1u-HII25M_McxkqECzvcGSrmRzui5lq8PlSDGZhyOBkQfViT3W8Dfu-wRT84XxLGFBCCg/LWgDs2Bu-pIDzEyldLEKYAWKLejUC-Rb/8 "This is a longer email but I respectfully ask you to read it from start to finish.")**_

It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up poor, raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction.

It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.

**But I felt called to tell my story. Warts and all.** I felt led to speak out because I think millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.

_As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC. _

Peter, Something’s been bugging me, so I want to get this off my chest. There’s been a lot of talk about how Democrats should focus on the economy instead of how folks are being _illegally detained and shipped off_ to El Salvador. I want to make this clear: **We can and must hold two things at once. ** We can simultaneously protect our basic liberties, stand up for all people to have due process and access to an attorney, and address problems with an economy that is working against us. I’m doing it every day in Congress. I’m calling for those who were illegally detained by border patrol to receive due process, and I’m demanding answers on wrongful arrests to keep attention on this administration’s anti-constitutional acts. At the same time, I’m pushing back against Trump’s chaotic tariff war and blatant billionaire-first agenda. **These two things are not mutually exclusive.** There is nothing more important than a man’s liberty, and if we ignore that, it’s to our own peril. I’m standing firm as a defender of our Constitution and the priorities of Vermont’s working families in Congress. clean_body: | = Peter, Something’s been bugging me, so I want to get this off my chest. There’s been a lot of talk about how Democrats should focus on the economy instead of how folks are being illegally detained and shipped off to El Salvador. I want to make this clear: We can and must hold two things at once. We can simultaneously protect our basic liberties, stand up for all people to have due process and access to an attorney, and address problems with an economy that is working against us. I’m doing it every day in Congress. I’m calling for those who were illegally detained by border patrol to receive due process, and I’m demanding answers on wrongful arrests to keep attention on this administration’s anti-constitutional acts. At the same time, I’m pushing back against Trump’s chaotic tariff war and blatant billionaire-first agenda. These two things are not mutually exclusive. There is nothing more important than a man’s liberty, and if we ignore that, it’s to our own peril. | Peter,

I recently sent you a Spring 2025 Priorities Survey to learn what issues are most important to you as we head toward November. I've had a chance to read the results, and I wanted to share the most consistent issues this team raised from the thousands of responses we received:

**✅ Defending our democracy
✅ Making health care more affordable
✅ Standing up to Donald Trump and Elon Musk
✅ Protecting reproductive rights
✅ Bringing down the cost of everyday goods**

* **TOP NEWS**

**"US judge temporarily stops west Texas immigrant deportations under Alien Enemies Act,** " AP's **John Raby** \-- "A federal judge in west Texas joined other courts in temporarily blocking the deportations of Venezuelan immigrants under an 18th-century wartime law known as the Alien Enemies Act.

U.S. District Judge **David Briones** in El Paso, Texas, issued the ruling Friday while he ordered the release of a couple accused of being members of a Venezuelan criminal gang. Briones wrote that government lawyers "have not demonstrated they have any lawful basis" to continue detaining the couple on a suspected alien enemy violation.

A message left with an attorney for the couple wasn't immediately returned Saturday.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/eb460b60-4da1-49b7-9310-4bbbc2af3703?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The couple is accused of being part of [Tren de Aragua](https://substack.com/redirect/46f84607-5b15-475d-bf2d-f56752fedfb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which the Trump administration has designated a [foreign terrorist organization](https://substack.com/redirect/c03b63ff-0086-400c-ac09-3a64a9f2e82a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Trump has invoked the [Alien Enemies Act](https://substack.com/redirect/01e1db22-48be-433d-855b-e3711027823b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from 1798 that lets the president deport noncitizens [14 years or older](https://substack.com/redirect/192ab94f-9b61-49d4-a6e1-e0a0600b216b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who are from a country with which the U.S. is at war.

Earlier this month, the [U.S. Supreme Court](https://substack.com/redirect/c8601250-0f8d-4eb9-827a-7ae797ed4d22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) blocked, for now, the deportations of any Venezuelans held in northern Texas under the act. The high court also ruled anyone being deported under Trump's declaration deserved a hearing in federal court first and are given "a reasonable time" to contest their pending removals.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/eb460b60-4da1-49b7-9310-4bbbc2af3703?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Briones' ruling applies only to Venezuelan immigrants in federal custody in his judicial district. Federal judges in [Colorado](https://substack.com/redirect/9035d7a1-b689-4655-b585-f4ad091d9da1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [south Texas and New York](https://substack.com/redirect/fa79ba09-5b65-4cc6-8189-995982c28892?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) previously issued similar rulings. Briones ordered the government to give a 21-day notice before attempting to remove anyone in west Texas -- in contrast to the 12 hours that the government contends is sufficient.

The El Paso case comes as the Trump administration and local authorities clash over the president's [sweeping immigration crackdown](https://substack.com/redirect/4a16ccb7-88b8-43dd-94fc-d9ff41ea1f2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Briones' ruling occurred the same day as the FBI's arrest of [a Milwaukee judge](https://substack.com/redirect/4133e31a-e4c5-4079-af0e-a224fa9cbf9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) accused of helping a man evade immigration authorities.

Briones, who was nominated to the court in 1994 by President **Bill Clinton** , said that "due process requirements for the removal of noncitizens are long established" under the Immigration and Nationality Act as well as previous U.S. Supreme Court rulings.

"There is no doubt the Executive Branch's unprecedented peacetime use of wartime power has caused chaos and uncertainty for individual petitions as well as the judicial branch in how to manage and evaluate the Executive's claims of Tren de Aragua membership, and the invocation of the Alien Enemies Act as a whole," Briones wrote.

The couple, **Julio Cesar Sanchez Puentes** and**Luddis Norelia Sanchez Garcia** , was granted temporary protected status after entering the United States from Mexico in October 2022. They were notified that their status was terminated on April 1.

They were arrested April 16 at the El Paso airport as the couple prepared to return to their home in Washington, D.C., where they live with their three children. They had flown to Texas for an April 14 pretrial hearing related to removal proceedings. That case was continued until June 23, and the couple was allowed to remain free on bail, according to court documents." U.S. District Judge David Briones in El Paso, Texas, issued the ruling Friday while he ordered the release of a couple accused of being members of a Venezuelan criminal gang. Briones wrote that government lawyers "have not demonstrated they have any lawful basis" to continue detaining the couple on a suspected alien enemy violation. A message left with an attorney for the couple wasn't immediately returned Saturday. The couple is accused of being part of , which the Trump administration has designated a . Trump has invoked the from 1798 that lets the president deport noncitizens who are from a country with which the U.S. is at war. Earlier this month, the blocked, for now, the deportations of any Venezuelans held in northern Texas under the act. The high court also ruled anyone being deported under Trump's declaration deserved a hearing in federal court first and are given "a reasonable time" to contest their pending removals. Briones' ruling applies only to Venezuelan immigrants in federal custody in his judicial district. Federal judges in , previously issued similar rulings. Briones ordered the government to give a 21-day notice before attempting to remove anyone in west Texas -- in contrast to the 12 hours that the government contends is sufficient. The El Paso case comes as the Trump administration and local authorities clash over the president's . Briones' ruling occurred the same day as the FBI's arrest of accused of helping a man evade immigration authorities. Briones, who was nominated to the court in 1994 by President Bill Clinton , said that "due process requirements for the removal of noncitizens are long established" under the Immigration and Nationality Act as well as previous U.S. Supreme Court rulings. "There is no doubt the Executive Branch's unprecedented peacetime use of wartime power has caused chaos and uncertainty for individual petitions as well as the judicial branch in how to manage and evaluate the Executive's claims of Tren de Aragua membership, and the invocation of the Alien Enemies Act as a whole," Briones wrote. The couple, Julio Cesar Sanchez Puentes andLuddis Norelia Sanchez Garcia , was granted temporary protected status after entering the United States from Mexico in October 2022. They were notified that their status was terminated on April 1. They were arrested April 16 at the El Paso airport as the couple prepared to return to their home in Washington, D.C., where they live with their three children. They had flown to Texas for an April 14 pretrial hearing related to removal proceedings. That case was continued until June 23, and the couple was allowed to remain free on bail, according to court documents." Some elected officials can't take a joke.

And unfortunately, they think they have the power to do something about it.

After the governor of California saw a video parody of a politician, he responded by saying the video should be "illegal." Then the California legislature fast-tracked and passed two bills, banning certain political speech.

_The Babylon Bee_ and other plaintiffs filed a lawsuit against California officials because the bills censor free speech and punish people for posting certain political content online, including political memes and parodies of politicians.

* **TOP NEWS**

**"US judge temporarily stops west Texas immigrant deportations under Alien Enemies Act,** " AP's **John Raby** \-- "A federal judge in west Texas joined other courts in temporarily blocking the deportations of Venezuelan immigrants under an 18th-century wartime law known as the Alien Enemies Act.

U.S. District Judge **David Briones** in El Paso, Texas, issued the ruling Friday while he ordered the release of a couple accused of being members of a Venezuelan criminal gang. Briones wrote that government lawyers "have not demonstrated they have any lawful basis" to continue detaining the couple on a suspected alien enemy violation.

A message left with an attorney for the couple wasn't immediately returned Saturday.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/422af950-fa80-4848-a345-414731c8a942?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The couple is accused of being part of [Tren de Aragua](https://substack.com/redirect/4f9ea751-d24b-428c-bbdb-f6e79620a2d7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which the Trump administration has designated a [foreign terrorist organization](https://substack.com/redirect/da25ed03-989c-410a-ba3c-a58cef19ffdb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Trump has invoked the [Alien Enemies Act](https://substack.com/redirect/e0b06749-3b3a-43fb-a6ed-2566f2e8b11c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from 1798 that lets the president deport noncitizens [14 years or older](https://substack.com/redirect/873f4ed7-3f34-4945-8066-db0a7f444858?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who are from a country with which the U.S. is at war.

Earlier this month, the [U.S. Supreme Court](https://substack.com/redirect/30176395-56a2-412b-abbb-21ce099a0832?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) blocked, for now, the deportations of any Venezuelans held in northern Texas under the act. The high court also ruled anyone being deported under Trump's declaration deserved a hearing in federal court first and are given "a reasonable time" to contest their pending removals.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/422af950-fa80-4848-a345-414731c8a942?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Briones' ruling applies only to Venezuelan immigrants in federal custody in his judicial district. Federal judges in [Colorado](https://substack.com/redirect/a7d9e5ea-73f2-4f5c-8c86-473fe5c69228?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [south Texas and New York](https://substack.com/redirect/0c370f9d-1232-4977-ba6c-23e8535f5e34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) previously issued similar rulings. Briones ordered the government to give a 21-day notice before attempting to remove anyone in west Texas -- in contrast to the 12 hours that the government contends is sufficient.

The El Paso case comes as the Trump administration and local authorities clash over the president's [sweeping immigration crackdown](https://substack.com/redirect/a3026bd6-05ac-4eef-b325-2522872d6c75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Briones' ruling occurred the same day as the FBI's arrest of [a Milwaukee judge](https://substack.com/redirect/eb43c386-1abb-48da-bf4a-e3a09ca140f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) accused of helping a man evade immigration authorities.

Briones, who was nominated to the court in 1994 by President **Bill Clinton** , said that "due process requirements for the removal of noncitizens are long established" under the Immigration and Nationality Act as well as previous U.S. Supreme Court rulings.

"There is no doubt the Executive Branch's unprecedented peacetime use of wartime power has caused chaos and uncertainty for individual petitions as well as the judicial branch in how to manage and evaluate the Executive's claims of Tren de Aragua membership, and the invocation of the Alien Enemies Act as a whole," Briones wrote.

The couple, **Julio Cesar Sanchez Puentes** and**Luddis Norelia Sanchez Garcia** , was granted temporary protected status after entering the United States from Mexico in October 2022. They were notified that their status was terminated on April 1.

They were arrested April 16 at the El Paso airport as the couple prepared to return to their home in Washington, D.C., where they live with their three children. They had flown to Texas for an April 14 pretrial hearing related to removal proceedings. That case was continued until June 23, and the couple was allowed to remain free on bail, according to court documents." TOP NEWS "US judge temporarily stops west Texas immigrant deportations under Alien Enemies Act, " AP's John Raby \-- "A federal judge in west Texas joined other courts in temporarily blocking the deportations of Venezuelan immigrants under an 18th-century wartime law known as the Alien Enemies Act. U.S. District Judge David Briones in El Paso, Texas, issued the ruling Friday while he ordered the release of a couple accused of being members of a Venezuelan criminal gang. Briones wrote that government lawyers "have not demonstrated they have any lawful basis" to continue detaining the couple on a suspected alien enemy violation. A message left with an attorney for the couple wasn't immediately returned Saturday. The couple is accused of being part of , which the Trump administration has designated a . Trump has invoked the from 1798 that lets the president deport noncitizens who are from a country with which the U.S. is at war. Earlier this month, the blocked, for now, the deportations of any Venezuelans held in northern Texas under the act. The high court also ruled anyone being deported under Trump's declaration deserved a hearing in federal court first and are given "a reasonable time" to contest their pending removals. Briones' ruling applies only to Venezuelan immigrants in federal custody in his judicial district. Federal judges in , previously issued similar rulings. Briones ordered the government to give a 21-day notice before attempting to remove anyone in west Texas -- in contrast to the 12 hours that the government contends is sufficient. The El Paso case comes as the Trump administration and local authorities clash over the president's . Briones' ruling occurred the same day as the FBI's arrest of accused of helping a man evade immigration authorities. Briones, who was nominated to the court in 1994 by President Bill Clinton , said that "due process requirements for the removal of noncitizens are long established" under the Immigration and Nationality Act as well as previous U.S. Supreme Court rulings. "There is no doubt the Executive Branch's unprecedented peacetime use of wartime power has caused chaos and uncertainty for individual petitions as well as the judicial branch in how to manage and evaluate the Executive's claims of Tren de Aragua membership, and the invocation of the Alien Enemies Act as a whole," Briones wrote. The couple, Julio Cesar Sanchez Puentes andLuddis Norelia Sanchez Garcia , was granted temporary protected status after entering the United States from Mexico in October 2022. They were notified that their status was terminated on April 1. They were arrested April 16 at the El Paso airport as the couple prepared to return to their home in Washington, D.C., where they live with their three children. They had flown to Texas for an April 14 pretrial hearing related to removal proceedings. That case was continued until June 23, and the couple was allowed to remain free on bail, according to court documents." Briones wrote that government lawyers “have not demonstrated they have any lawful basis” to continue detaining the couple on a suspected alien enemy violation. A message left with an attorney for the couple wasn’t immediately returned Saturday. » The couple is accused of being part of , which the Trump administration has designated a . Trump has invoked the from 1798 that lets the president deport noncitizens who are from a country with which the U.S. is at war. Earlier this month, the blocked, for now, the deportations of any Venezuelans held in northern Texas under the act. The high court also ruled anyone being deported under Trump’s declaration deserved a hearing in federal court first and are given “a reasonable time” to contest their pending removals. » Briones’ ruling applies only to Venezuelan immigrants in federal custody in his judicial district. Federal judges in , previously issued similar rulings. Briones ordered the government to give a 21-day notice before attempting to remove anyone in west Texas — in contrast to the 12 hours that the government contends is sufficient. The El Paso case comes as the Trump administration and local authorities clash over the president’s . Briones’ ruling occurred the same day as the FBI’s arrest of accused of helping a man evade immigration authorities. Briones, who was nominated to the court in 1994 by President Bill Clinton , said that “due process requirements for the removal of noncitizens are long established” under the Immigration and Nationality Act as well as previous U.S. Supreme Court rulings. “There is no doubt the Executive Branch’s unprecedented peacetime use of wartime power has caused chaos and uncertainty for individual petitions as well as the judicial branch in how to manage and evaluate the Executive’s claims of Tren de Aragua membership, and the invocation of the Alien Enemies Act as a whole,” Briones wrote. The couple, Julio Cesar Sanchez Puentes andLuddis Norelia Sanchez Garcia , was granted temporary protected status after entering the United States from Mexico in October 2022. They were notified that their status was terminated on April 1. They were arrested April 16 at the El Paso airport as the couple prepared to return to their home in Washington, D.C., where they live with their three children. They had flown to Texas for an April 14 pretrial hearing related to removal proceedings. That case was continued until June 23, and the couple was allowed to remain free on bail, according to court documents." | FREE SUBSCRIPTIONS HAVE ENDED : As of July 11, 2022, we have moved to a paywall for free subscribers. subject: April 28 Campaign Update
body:
A Milwaukee Judge has been charged with obstructing ICE.

| | | | | [|
---](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=72f45458dc&e=e907534017)
| | | | | **April 28, 2025**
---
| Here’s an update from our campaign:
---
| | | | |
# Liberal Milwaukee Judge Charged with Obstruction
---
| Last week, news [**broke**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=843a775e85&e=e907534017) that a Milwaukee County Judge was charged with obstructing ICE and federal agents. [**Reporting**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=5bf81f741c&e=e907534017) indicates that the official took steps to move an illegal immigrant, who was appearing for charges on battery and domestic assault, through a non-public exit to avoid authorities.
These actions follow just days after **radical Tony Evers** instructed state officials to not assist ICE.
---
[|
---](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=ea97eabc7b&e=e907534017)
| According to the [**criminal complaint**](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=9d26835bf4&e=e907534017) , federal law enforcement agents, including ICE, entered the Milwaukee County Courthouse on April 18th to apprehend **Eduardo Flores-Ruiz**. Flores-Ruiz, an illegal immigrant previously deported in 2013, was scheduled for a court hearing on multiple counts of **domestic violence** and **battery.**
Eyewitness accounts alleged that Judge Dugan confronted ICE agents in a public hallway and sent them to another area of the courthouse. While agents were away, the complaint highlights that Judge Dugan moved Flores-Ruiz through a non-public space, potentially to _**avoid capture by federal agents**_. A plain-clothes DEA agent followed Flores-Ruiz and confronted him outside the courthouse, where a foot chase ensured.
Let me be clear, Judge Dugan’s actions could have endangered the lives of law enforcement and the public.
---
[|
---](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=482950280c&e=e907534017)
| Obstruction is a serious charge and one that should apply equally regardless of whether or not the individual is a defendant, witness, or a sitting judicial official. While Judge Dugan deserves her day in court, this appears to be a **textbook case of obstruction**.
_**I’m committed to securing our border and protecting our communities.**_
Now more than ever, state and federal officials should work together to help enforce our immigration laws, particularly when it comes to violent criminals and repeat offenders. It’s disappointing to see a number of **liberal politicians** **and activists** fight against this approach.
---
|
# Traveling Across the District
---
| I also spent last week traveling across the 1st Congressional District, visiting Wisconsin family-owned businesses, local festivals, and community events to talk with Wisconsin families about what matters most to them.
---
[|
---](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=de4f7c129c&e=e907534017)
| One of the highlights of my weekend was volunteering at the Roma Lodge for the annual Racine Pancake Day. I hope you were able to join us for a great breakfast on Saturday!
---
| **On Wisconsin,** Bryan Steil

* * *
Donald Trump, Elon Musk and Marjorie Taylor Greene are fighting to defund programs like Sesame Street, _PBS_ , and _NPR_. They’re claiming that Sesame Street brainwashes viewers and children with “communist” agendas and promotes “anti-American” views.

We refuse to let _PBS_ and Sesame Street get cancelled by the GOP’s extremist agenda.

[ **_We need you and every other person reading this email to sign our Emergency Petition. Help us gather 30,000 signatures before 9:00 AM EST tomorrow >>**_](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/60749?t=6&akid=23025%2E4449941%2E2Sfffi)
[SIGN NOW →](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/60749?t=7&akid=23025%2E4449941%2E2Sfffi)
---
It’s critically important we fight back. If we fail:
**→ FIRST: Millions of Americans would lose access to educational and news programming.

→ SECOND: Beloved programs like Sesame Street, Curious George, and local sports coverage would be SHUT DOWN.

→ THIRD: The GOP’s hateful, anti-journalist agenda will gain momentum. Their lies about ‘propaganda’ inside public programming will continue dividing our country.**
A top executive at _PBS_ put it perfectly: “There’s nothing more American than PBS.”

We know that many Americans agree with us that we can’t let the GOP’s political games result in us losing educational staples like Sesame Street. But agreeing isn’t enough, we need you to sign our emergency petition.
[ **_SIGN NOW: Add your name to our emergency petition calling on Congress to protect _PBS_ and programs like Sesame Street →_**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/60749?t=8&akid=23025%2E4449941%2E2Sfffi)
[SIGN NOW →](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/60749?t=9&akid=23025%2E4449941%2E2Sfffi)
---
Thanks,

_Fight for Reform_

| | Good afternoon!

Last week the legislature sent the governor an emergency supplemental appropriation [bill](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=64ffe7be3d&e=a7ab36849c) to fund the developmental disabilities program.

Over the weekend, I participated in a policy panel on federalism with a state representative from Utah and a superintendent of education from South Carolina. I highlighted the importance of state’s rights – devolving the power back to the states whether there is a republican or democrat in the White House. I highlighted Arizona’s many school choice successes, the urgent need for holding our state superintendent accountable for the state’s empowerment scholarship account program and keeping it centric to our families who utilize the program, not unelected bureaucrats.

**Bolick Bills Voted Out of the House Today**

SB 1103
penalty assessment; victims' rights enforcement

SB 1449
lifetime injunction; undesignated offenses

SB 1527
occupational boards; renewal extension

_Bolick Legislation in the News_

[https://swvalleytimes.com/stories/670999228-shawnna-lm-bolick-discusses-legislative-matters-and-collaboration-on-social-media](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ef67d9be27&e=a7ab36849c)

[https://gilaherald.com/stolen-valor-act-signed-into-law/](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c2c48cffc4&e=a7ab36849c)

I still have quite a few bills still moving through the House, including a [ballot referral](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=89234244e6&e=a7ab36849c) to ban foreign donations in our elections. I sponsored a similar bill last year, but the former chair for the House Committee on Elections refused to grant it a hearing, so I sponsored it again this current legislative session. It would have been nice to solve this issue during the 2024 election cycle. Instead, hopefully you will have a chance to vote on it in 2026.

_Campaign Information_

If you live in Legislative District 2, [**please sign my online nomination petition**](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=5b9a389aa7&e=a7ab36849c) ensuring my name appears on the Republican primary ballot. To qualify from the Republican ballot, I need to collect more than 500 valid signatures from registered Republicans and Independents. It only takes a minute or two to login to sign your name on my online nominate petition.

Thank you for your continued support!

Take care,
Shawnna

| | Peter,
One of communism’s well-known critics, George Orwell, once said:
“ _If liberty means anything at all, it means the right to tell people what they do not want to hear._ ”
Colorado is gearing up to pass a law that would **make a parent's refusal to acknowledge a child’s preferred name or gender constitute child abuse**.
[HB25-1312 Legal Protections for Transgender Individuals](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) has been passed in the Colorado House and is likely to soon do the same in the Senate, after which it will go to the Governor's desk for final approval. _If this happens, parents could lose custody of their children for refusing to buy in to their misguided fantasies_.
The truth is often something that people don’t want to hear, but it is the key to being free. The Rocky Mountain Voice is committed to providing Coloradans with the truth, no matter how unpopular it is.
Peter, can we count on you to become a monthly supporter in the fight for the truth here in Colorado?
---
[Fight for Truth!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Above all else, RMV champions liberty in Colorado and builds a community of trust among traditional, grassroots citizens.
We provide pro-citizen journalism that prioritizes facts over feelings. Your sustained contribution of [$50, $25, or even $10 per month](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) gives RMV the tools we need to keep Coloradans informed about what's _really_ happening at our State Capitol in Denver.
The Rocky Mountain Voice is free to all who want to hear the truth. We don't hide behind paywalls, because we want our message to be available to everyone. Will you help us arm citizens with knowledge and defend liberty in the Centennial State today?
[Yes, I Will!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

Yesterday, I sat on the Capitol steps and shared one of the most painful memories of my life: holding my husband Andy’s hand as he took his last breaths after a battle with cancer.
That experience is why I will never stop fighting Republican attempts to cut access to health care.
**Predictably, Stephen Miller jumped at the opportunity to distract his audience by using schoolyard taunts against me.**

We know that Republicans and Donald Trump are seriously trying to flip New Mexico red, and we can expect them to spend a lot of money to do it.

Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Deb Haaland is running for Governor in New Mexico and needs our help.
